## 03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_O

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_O&lang=en)

### 中文

信息布告：由[Root.GetSpeciesName]发起的看守者项目致力于为所有受§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!威胁的有机文明提供一个安全，可靠的庇护所，将近万亿的智慧生物现已入住我们最先进的庇护所，重新找到了安居之所。

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:10`

## 01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL&lang=en)

### 中文

信息布告：阿尔法庇护所是[Root.GetSpeciesName]为看守者项目所创立的第一座庇护所。阿尔法庇护所配置的居住单元能够承载接近一百亿智慧生物，同时庇护所内还另配有容量达三百亿的低温仓设施。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:9`

### English

Information bulletin: Alpha Refuge is the first refuge constructed by the [Root.GetSpeciesName] for the Custodian Project. It is capable of housing approximately 10 billion sapient organics in the Habitation Unit, as well as an additional 30 billion in cryogenic stasis.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:11`

## 02_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL&lang=en)

### 中文

信息布告：贝塔庇护所的设计之初是专门为生命体多种提供环境良好的居所，然而在建造过程中，容量问题使我们不得已将贝塔庇护所改建为低温仓。§Y<通知，贝塔庇护所目前已满负荷，不再接收更多难民。>§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:10`

### English

Information bulletin: Beta Refuge was meant to be fully dedicated to habitation units, but capacity issues forced a shift in focus towards cryogenics during construction. §Y<NOTICE: Beta Refuge is currently at capacity and not accepting additional refugees.>§!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:12`

## 03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL&lang=en)

### 中文

信息布告：伽马庇护所从一开始便是以最多生物庇护数量为设计目标的。伽马庇护所能为数以千亿的智慧生物提供低温仓设备。§Y<通知，伽马庇护所目前已满员，不再接受更多难民。>§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:11`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:13`

## 04_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_FALLEN_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ENIGMATIC_GREETING_ALL&lang=en)

### 中文

信息布告：德尔塔庇护所从设计之始一直都以存活性为首要目标。德尔塔庇护所的特色有二：特别加固过的外部障壁，针对有机生命体的居住地区域化的设计；这使得即使在一些不大可能发生的事件，如环结构受损的情况下，在此居住的有机体依然能够维持生存。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:12`

### English

Information bulletin: Delta Refuge was designed with survivability in mind. It features a reinforced shell and compartmentalized design capable of sustaining organic inhabitants in the unlikely event of the ring's structural integrity being compromised.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:14`

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A12_NEUTRAL_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesName]，宗教教条是诸多恶毒之源。我们希望你们能重新考量一下你们那些不理智的唯心主义的想法。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:83`

### English

Religious dogma has been the source of much evil, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We wish you would reconsider your irrational spiritualism.

## 15_NEUTRAL_GREETING

我们是[Root.GetName]。

We are the [Root.GetName].

### 中文

我们希望你们管理好你们的民众，[From.GetSpeciesName]。要是让每个人都自由发展的话，那是一件很危险的事情。

### English

### English

Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] would like to know more about your species.

We are pleased to hear from you, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.

### English

Well met, friends. Let us know if there is something the [Root.GetName] can do for you.

## 03_FRIENDLY_GREETING

The [Root.GetName] stands ready to assist you, friends.

## 04_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

看到一张熟悉的[From.GetSpeciesName]脸庞一直是一件愉快的事情。你有什么需要[Root.GetName]做的吗？

### English

It is always good to see a familiar [From.GetSpeciesName] face. Is there something you need from the [Root.GetName]?

## 05_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

祝你们的国家永远和平，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。

May your nation always be at peace, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.

## 06_FRIENDLY_GREETING

### 中文

也许你们强大的军力可以通过威慑其他国家来促进和平。我们相信你们的判断，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:101`

### English

Perhaps your military promotes peace by acting as a deterrent to other nations. We trust in your judgment, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:111`

## 07_FRIENDLY_GREETING

[Root.GetName]向尊贵的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发出诚挚的问候。您有什么需要我们帮忙的，请尽管说。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:102`

### English

The [Root.GetName] greets its friends, the noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let us know if there is anything our forces can assist you with.

## 08_FRIENDLY_GREETING

### 中文

朋友，我们希望你们能加强军事力量。[Root.GetName]不可能时时刻刻保护你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:103`

### English

We urge you to strengthen your military, friend. The [Root.GetName] will not always be available to protect you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:113`

## 09_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A09_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

真心祝福你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]同志们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:104`

### English

Blessings upon you, [From.GetSpeciesName] comrades.

## 10_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A10_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

朋友们，请记住，即便你们信奉了错误的唯物主义的哲学，我们也还是一直在为你们祈祷。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:105`

### English

Know that you are in our prayers, friends, despite your misguided philosophies of materialism.

## 11_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A11_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎你们，[From.GetSpeciesName]朋友。你们的研究如何了？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:106`

### English

Greetings to you, [From.GetSpeciesName] friends. How goes your research?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:116`

## 12_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A12_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

有些人视你们为宗教狂信者，但是我们充分理解你们的行为。你们想谈些什么呢，朋友？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:107`

### English

Some would call your people religious zealots, but we know better. Was there something you wanted to discuss, friend?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:117`

## 13_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A13_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的民众已经把你们的人民视如挚友了，[From.GetSpeciesName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:108`

### English

Our citizens have come to regard your people as friends, [From.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:118`

## 14_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A14_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们更崇尚自由社会，但是我们不能否认你们的政府很好地满足了你们公民的需求。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:109`

### English

While we prefer free societies, we cannot deny that your government does a good job of seeing to the needs of your citizens.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:119`

## 16_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A16_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

贵国政府在遏制过于激进的平等主义方面很有一套，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:111`

### English

Your government does a good job of curtailing the worst excesses of egalitarianism, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:121`

## 17_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A17_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

作为外星人，你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]真是惊人的……易于相处。[Root.GetName]能为你做些什么呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:112`

### English

For aliens, you [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are surprisingly... agreeable. What can the [Root.GetName] do for you?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:122`

## 18_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A18_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们作为一个异星物种却赢得了[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]的尊敬。这是很少见的。我们能帮助你们做些什么呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:113`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been lauded by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] as a rare example of an alien species worthy of our respect. How can I be of assistance?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:123`

## 19_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A19_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

跟你们的交谈实在是太高兴了，我差点儿忘了你们是外星人，[From.GetSpeciesName]。差点儿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:114`

### English

I almost forget that I am talking to an alien when I converse with you, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Almost.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:124`

## 20_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A20_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

星系充满了恐怖的外星人，能见到其他[From.GetSpeciesName]总是很令人欣喜不已。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:115`

### English

In a galaxy brimming over with alien horrors, it is always delightful to see another [From.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:125`

## 21_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A21_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

很高兴见到你们，美丽的[From.GetSpeciesName][From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]。我们能能够帮助你什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:116`

### English

We are delighted to see you, beautiful [From.GetSpeciesName] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]. How can we be of assistance?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:126`

## 22_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A22_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

我们[Root.GetName]可以从你们身上学习到很多东西，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们是我们所有人的榜样。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:117`

### English

The [Root.GetName] can learn much from your species, [From.GetSpeciesName]. You are an example to us all.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:127`

## 23_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A23_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

看到你们那异域风情的外貌，我们[Root.GetSpeciesOrganName]非常高兴！你要知道[From.GetSpeciesName]文化在[Root.Capital.GetName]的圈子里很受欢迎！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:118`

### English

My [Root.GetSpeciesOrganName] rumbles with joy at the sight of your exotic visage! You should know that [From.GetSpeciesName] culture is quite popular in many circles on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:128`

## 24_FRIENDLY_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A24_FRIENDLY_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

朋友们，很高兴见到你们。要不要就我们目前遇到过的外星生物交换一下意见？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:119`

### English

Good to see you, friends. Shall we compare notes on the various alien life forms we have thus far encountered?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:129`

## 01_WAR_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_WAR_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

你们想讨论一下你们的投降条件吗，[From.GetSpeciesName]？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:120`

### English

Do you wish to discuss the terms of your surrender, [From.GetSpeciesName]?

## 02_WAR_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_WAR_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesName]，你们不可能一直躲在[From.Capital.GetName]不出来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:121`

### English

You cannot hide on [From.Capital.GetName] forever, [From.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:131`

## 03_WAR_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_WAR_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

你们即将见识到[Root.GetName]的全部实力，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:122`

### English

You are about to face the full might of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:132`

## 04_WAR_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_WAR_GREETING&lang=en)

### 中文

别以为你们是[From.GetSpeciesName]我们就会手下留情。胜利属于我们！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:123`

### English

Do not think we will go easy on you because you are [From.GetSpeciesName]. Victory shall be ours!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:133`

## 05_WAR_GREETING

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_WAR_GREETING&lang=en)

## HW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可以把你们当作战友，但若是没有勇气，力量便毫无用处。你们要是能证明自己，无论是盟友还是敌人，我们都会把你们平等对待。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:214`

### English

We can see that you are fellow warriors, but strength matters little without valor. Prove yourselves and we shall treat you as equals, whether ally or enemy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:225`

## HW_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们承认现在是你们比较强，但你们要知道，[Root.GetSpeciesName]不会畏惧任何敌人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:215`

### English

We acknowledge your superior power, but know that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] fear no enemy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:226`

## HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

愿我们在敌人的[Root.GetBloodType]与灰烬之中并肩作战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:216`

### English

May we stand together in the [Root.GetBloodType] and ashes of our enemies.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:227`

## HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

除了和我们的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]朋友庆祝过去和未来的胜利，还有什么更好的方式能够不负这片刻和平吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:217`

### English

What better way to spend this time of peace than to celebrate past and future triumphs with our [From.GetSpeciesAdj] friends?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:228`

## HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们此战将会成为传奇流传百世。我们会邀请你们来一起庆祝我们即将到来的光荣时刻的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:218`

### English

Legends of our ongoing war will be retold for millennia. You will be invited to celebrate our forthcoming glory, [From.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:229`

## HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

希望你们的纯真能够免受星系中臭名昭著的恶棍们的困扰，[From.GetSpeciesName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:219`

### English

May your innocence remain untrampled by the dishonorable villains of the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:230`

## HW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

能和你们这样高尚的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]并肩作战真的很愉快。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:220`

### English

It will be a joy to fight side by side with noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] such as you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:231`

## HW_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不会怜悯，只是心怀正义。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:221`

### English

We offer no mercy, only justice.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:232`

## HW_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

用你们的武器说话吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:222`

### English

Let your weapons do the talking.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:233`

## HW_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

让我们友善地解决这一切并战斗到最后一刻吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:223`

### English

Let us resolve this amicably, by fighting until the very end.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:234`

## RC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

生意是最重要的，而你们能做的最好的事情就是滚远点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:225`

### English

Business comes first, and the best thing for you would be to stay out of ours.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:236`

## RC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

不管你们是为如何荒谬而不切实际的价值而活，你们都没办法了解硬通货的价值和现实。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:226`

### English

Whatever absurd immaterial values you claim to live for, they have blinded you to the hard currencies we deal in and to reality itself.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:237`

## RC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

也许你们还在期待我们会对你们这样可怜的生物心怀怜悯。你们真是大错特错。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:227`

### English

Perhaps you expect us to extend generosity to such pitiful creatures as yourselves. You couldn't be more wrong.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:238`

## RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

那些无法与之共同获利的人，我们定会榨取其价值。仔细想想你们想成为哪一类吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:228`

### English

Those who cannot be profited with must be profited from. Consider carefully to which category you'd like to belong.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:239`

## RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们会给新的合作伙伴提供最好的条件。我们别再这里讨论这些细节了；你们想个大致的方向，我们来起草合同。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:229`

### English

We offer only the best deals for new associates. Let's not get too bogged down with the details; you paint the broad strokes and we'll draft the contract.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:240`

## RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们对超自然的兴趣十分迷人。建议你们继续探索这些深奥的珍宝，远离这腐败堕落的物质世界。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:230`

### English

Your interest in the metaphysical is intriguing. We suggest you continue to explore these esoteric treasures and leave this corrupting material plane in our care.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:241`

## RC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

不要提那种太过分的要求。当我们裁员的时候，子公司总是我们最先考虑的对象。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:231`

### English

Don't get too bold in your requests. When we downsize, subsidiaries are always the first to go.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:242`

## RC_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可能会愿意做出一些利益上的妥协，以适应你们强硬的立场。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:232`

### English

We may be willing to compromise our interests somewhat to accommodate your strong position.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:243`

## RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

保持良好的合作关系的关键就是对彼此足够诚实，乃至我们对其他人撒谎也能心照不宣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:233`

### English

The key to a good partnership is to be just honest enough with each other to make the lies we tell to the others line up.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:244`

## RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们很愿意相信你们，更重要的是，我们也很愿意成为你们可靠的伙伴。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:234`

### English

We're willing to trust you, and more exceptionally, we're willing to be trustworthy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:245`

## RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们绝对不可能一起吃亏的。现在我们要做的就是找个人来承担损失。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:235`

### English

There's no reason why both of us can't profit. Now all we need is to find someone to take the losses.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:246`

## RC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你对我们之间的合作还有什么建议吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:236`

### English

Do you have any new suggestions for our joint venture?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:247`

## RC_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

战争只不过是经济竞争的另一种延续方式。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:237`

### English

War is merely the continuation of economic competition by other means.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:248`

## RC_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

既然你们不愿听道理，我们别无选择，只能动用强制手段了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:238`

### English

Since you refuse to be compelled by reason, you leave us no choice but to compel you by force.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:249`

## RC_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们都没必要把这次冲突当做是针对个人的；这只是底线问题。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:239`

### English

There is no reason for either of us to take this conflict personally; it's simply about the bottom line.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:250`

## RC_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

恶性的收购即将发生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:240`

### English

A hostile takeover is imminent.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:251`

## PT_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

可惜了，和坏人谈生意通常没有好结果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:242`

### English

It's a shame good deals can rarely be made with bad people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:253`

## PT_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesName]很渴望和其他人交流经验，但我们基本上没从你们那里得到些什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:243`

### English

The [Root.GetSpeciesName] seek to learn from others and have them learn from us, but we'd rather not learn any of your ways.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:254`

## PT_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

看起来很明显的是，你们更愿意用狭隘与偏见阻塞互相受益的道路。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:244`

### English

It seems clear that you're willing to let narrow-mindedness and prejudice stand in the way of mutual benefit.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:255`

## PT_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

这太省事了－你们没什么东西给我们，而我们恰好也不想和你们分享什么。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:245`

### English

How convenient that you have so little to offer us, since we have no desire to share with you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:256`

## PT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们一直在倾听。不管我们发展得多么好，或者我们沦落到如何凄惨的地步，别人总是能教给我们一些新的东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:246`

### English

We're listening. No matter how high we rise or how low we fall, others will always have something new to offer.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:257`

## PT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们能遇上你们真的很幸运。我们这个物种的繁荣源于各种文化之间的交流。我们希望我们和[From.GetSpeciesName]之间的关系会成为这伟大旅途中的下一步。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:247`

### English

We are fortunate to have met. Our species prospered through the exchanges between civilizations. We hope our relationship with the [From.GetSpeciesName] will be the next step on this great journey.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:258`

## PT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的精神信仰分散了你们的注意力，使得你们无法看到我们提供给你们的机会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:248`

### English

Your people's unworldly ways are distracting you from the opportunities we can show you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:259`

## PT_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

出于对你们的尊重，我们会尽量降低一些货物的价格。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:249`

### English

As a token of respect, we'll try to arrange for a reduced price on some of our goods.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:260`

## PT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

和聪明的商业伙伴交流总是很愉快的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:250`

### English

Always a pleasure to talk to a sensible business partner.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:261`

## PT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们乐意见到[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]对建设性的讨论和事务感兴趣，不像那些渴望权力的统治者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:251`

### English

We're glad to see [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] is interested in constructive discussion and transactions, unlike so many power-hungry rulers.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:262`

## PT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

让我们一起合作，把繁荣和前所未见的财富扩散到整个星系的每一个角落。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:252`

### English

Together, we shall bring prosperity and unseen treasures to every corner of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:263`

## PT_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

不管谁是胜利者，这场冲突的后果就是我们会消耗无尽的资源去摧毁对方，这和互利互惠背道而驰。仔细想想你想要哪种结果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:253`

### English

No matter who is victorious, we will both have spent endless resources destroying each other by the end of this conflict, quite the opposite of a mutually beneficial transaction. Think hard on which you prefer.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:264`

## PT_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的舰船只想携带货物，而不是武器。每一件毁灭性的载货都会浪费宝贵的空间和生命。我们希望你们不要拖泥带水。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:254`

### English

Our ships were meant to carry wares, not weapons. Every destructive payload wastes valuable space and life. We hope you won't insist on dragging this out.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:265`

## PT_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

进行和平谈判，是我们再次开始有意义的对话的第一步。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:255`

### English

Negotiating the terms for peace will be the first step towards opening a meaningful dialogue again.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:266`

## HI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们为什么要浪费我们的时间？[Root.GetName]能繁荣昌盛，可不是因为经常聆听毫无意义的[Root.GetRandomSpeciesSound]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:257`

### English

Why are you wasting our time? The [Root.GetName] did not grow great by listening to wanton [Root.GetRandomSpeciesSound].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:268`

## HI_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

整个星系等着被[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]统治，而你却想着要谈判？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:258`

### English

The galaxy awaits the reign of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName], and you want negotiations?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:269`

## HI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们这些家伙怎么称呼自己的来着？啊对，是“[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]”这个词吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:259`

### English

What did you creatures call yourselves again? Right, "[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]" is the word.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:270`

## HI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

别担心。你们加入[Root.GetName]的时机会到来的，耐心一点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:260`

### English

Don't worry. Your time to join the [Root.GetName] will come, just be patient.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:271`

## HI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们听着呢，但我们会自己判断真相和谎言、正确和谬误。我们是对的，而你们还有待观察。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:261`

### English

We are listening, but we determine for ourselves what is truth and falsehood, right and wrong. We are right, what you are remains to be seen.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:272`

## HI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

只有实力才是宇宙通用的语言，但要是你们想说一些外交辞令的话，我们倒也不会阻拦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:262`

### English

Power is the only universal language, but if you wish to speak more diplomatically, we won't stop you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:273`

## HI_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们希望你们[From.GetRulerTitle]的无尽的智慧能够让你们看清，我们对你们的计划没有威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:263`

### English

We hope your [From.GetRulerTitle]'s unbounded wisdom allows you to see that we pose no threat to your plans.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:274`

## HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

一些文明是注定要统治其他文明的。作为统治者，我们会彼此尊重。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:264`

### English

Some civilizations are destined to rule, others to be ruled. As rulers, we can show each other respect.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:275`

## HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们很明智的没有反对我们，相应地，我们同样也会对你们保持尊重的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:265`

### English

You are wise not to oppose us, and we will extend the same courtesy to you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:276`

## HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们将一起击溃星系中所有敢于抵抗我们统治的势力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:266`

### English

Together, we will demolish every trace of resistance to our sovereign control of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:277`

## HI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

如果其他文明在我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]面前能像你们一样轻易放下武器，整个星系很快就会迎来你所希望的和平了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:267`

### English

If only everyone would lay down their arms before our [Root.GetRulerTitle] as readily as you seem willing to give up yours, the galaxy would surely see the peace you wish for.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:278`

## HI_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

一旦你们的防御瓦解，[From.GetSpeciesAdj]民众们会夹道欢迎[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]的统治的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:268`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people will welcome the rule of [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] once your defenses are crushed.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:279`

## HI_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

这场战争只不过是通向我们真正命运路上的一块垫脚石。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:269`

### English

This war is but a stepping stone on the road to our true destiny.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:280`

## HI_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们统一之前，[Root.GetName]经受过很多次战争的考验。这样的冲突只会让我们更加强大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:270`

### English

The [Root.GetName] was tested by many wars before we were united. This conflict will only make us stronger.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:281`

## FB_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

很多人可能会因为你们卑劣的政策而永远把[From.GetSpeciesName]当成怪物，但是我们从来不会无视任何一个物种。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:272`

### English

Many may forever reject the [From.GetSpeciesName] as monsters for your vile policies, but we never consider the lives of a species forfeit.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:283`

## FB_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们抗拒这条通往和平共处的道路的时间越久，星系中就会有越来越多的文明联合起来对付你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:273`

### English

The longer you reject the road to peaceful coexistence, the more of the galaxy will come together against you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:284`

## FB_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

当你们南征北战的时候，你留下的那些纷纷扰扰会成为星系的伤口。我们会去抚平那些伤口，但绝对不会忘记是谁造成的伤疤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:274`

### English

Whenever you divide and conquer, the division you leave behind is a wound upon the galaxy. We will tend to those wounds, but we won't forget who made them.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:285`

## FB_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

总会有一小撮别有用心的[From.GetRulerTitle]们不愿意让他们的人民加入星际社区。不过没关系，他们迟早会接受的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:275`

### English

There will always be petty [From.GetRulerTitle]s who are unwilling to let their people join the galactic community. You'll come around.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:286`

## FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们还处于星系历史的早期。我们越快进行合作，我们就能越快取得更大的成果并获取更多领土。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:276`

### English

We are still in the early days of galactic history. The sooner we embrace cooperation, the sooner we can advance to greater things and new frontiers.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:287`

## FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

作为[Root.GetAllianceName]的代表，外交是我们的首选策略。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:277`

### English

As representatives of the [Root.GetAllianceName], diplomacy is our first priority.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:288`

## FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetAllianceName]会在互相依赖的必要前提之下保证自立性。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:278`

### English

The [Root.GetAllianceName] ensures independence where it matters through interdependence where it's needed.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:289`

## FB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你放弃使用武力走出了让整个星系迈向和平的第一步，但是只有化解我们之间的差异，我们才能实现更长久的和平。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:279`

### English

You have taken the first step to a peaceful galaxy by rejecting violence, but lasting peace can only be achieved by reconciling our differences.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:290`

## FB_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]或许很强大，但是如果弱者们联合起来对抗你们的话，这种强大就毫无意义。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:280`

### English

The [From.GetName] may be powerful, but that strength will matter little if the weak unite against you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:291`

## FB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

外交是所有星际社会的基础。[From.GetRulerName]认同这一点，足以见得其是一位明智的领袖。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:281`

### English

Diplomacy should be the cornerstone of all interstellar societies. The fact that [From.GetRulerName] appreciates this is surely the sign of a wise leader.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:292`

## FB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetAllianceName]的朋友就是和平与繁荣的朋友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:282`

### English

A friend of the [Root.GetAllianceName] is a friend of peace and prosperity.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:293`

## FB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetAllianceName]要是没有了伟大的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]引领方向，就会成为一个无足轻重的联邦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:283`

### English

The [Root.GetAllianceName] would be a lesser federation without its incandescent [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] to shine the way.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:294`

## FB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们今日的协议将被铭记，它不仅是建立[Root.GetAllianceName]的伟大计划，更是在开拓星系的未来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:284`

### English

Our accords today will be remembered as part of the great project of building the [Root.GetAllianceName], the future of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:295`

## FB_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

希望在战争中失去的生命会让你们想起已经摈弃的价值观。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:285`

### English

We hope the lives lost in this war will teach you the value of what you are throwing away.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:296`

## FB_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们建立[Root.GetAllianceName]的目的就是要保护整个星系不受[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]那样的战争狂威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:286`

### English

We formed the [Root.GetAllianceName] to protect the galaxy from warmongers like [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:297`

## FB_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetAllianceName]会联合起来对抗[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:287`

### English

The [Root.GetAllianceName] stands united against the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] threat.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:298`

## XI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不想与任何人打交道。这对于[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]来说是个很难理解的概念吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:289`

### English

All we want is to be left alone. Is that such a difficult concept for a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] to understand?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:300`

## XI_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们[From.GetSpeciesMouthName]发出的令人厌恶的[From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]声就像[Root.Capital.GetName]上的低级动物排泄液体一样，所以你们也会受到相应的待遇。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:290`

### English

The repulsive [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] your [From.GetSpeciesMouthName] emits sounds like the expulsion of fluids from a lesser species on [Root.Capital.GetName] and will be treated accordingly.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:301`

## XI_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你在这些交易背后到底暗藏着什么阴谋？是想要根除[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]文化吗？想要混种？你太恶心了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:291`

### English

What is your agenda behind these exchanges? The eradication of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] culture? Crossbreeding? You disgust us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:302`

## XI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们才不愿意让我们的文化被你们原始的价值观念污染。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:292`

### English

We have no desire to see our culture sullied by your primitive values.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:303`

## XI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

说简短点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:293`

### English

Keep this brief.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:304`

## XI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

要是我们都不与人来往的话，外交活动就没有必要展开了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:294`

### English

If we both kept to ourselves, diplomacy wouldn't be necessary.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:305`

## XI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

放心，我们和你一样反感这次互动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:295`

### English

Rest assured that we are just as averse as yourselves to this interaction.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:306`

## XI_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

离我们远点！我们会封锁超空间航道来隔离你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:296`

### English

Stay away from us! We'll barricade the fabric of spacetime itself to keep you out.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:307`

## XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你是开化的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，还是其中的佼佼者。我们可以和你交流。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:297`

### English

You're civilized [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], some of the better ones out there. We'll talk to you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:308`

## XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

只要你们跟同族呆在一起，我们就能达成共识。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:298`

### English

As long as you stay with your own kind, we have an understanding.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:309`

## XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

很多人不懂保持物种隔离的重要性。[From.GetRulerName]真是个明智的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:299`

### English

Many do not understand the importance of keeping species separate. [From.GetRulerName] is a sensible [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:310`

## XI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

不要认为我们对你们的容忍政策和你们病态的亲外倾向一样。我们不喜欢你们，也不喜欢任何人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:300`

### English

Don't assume our policy of tolerating you is similar to your own unhealthy interest in alien life. It's not like we actually like you or anything.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:311`

## XI_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

是你逼我们的。不要以为我们会允许[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]继续攻击我们美好的社会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:301`

### English

You forced our hand. Don't think we'd ever allow assaults on our beautiful society from [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] to continue.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:312`

## XI_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

在肃清[From.GetSpeciesAdj]威胁之后，我们的伟大目标和生活方式就能得到保障。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:302`

### English

Our objectives and our way of life will be secure once the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] menace is subjugated.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:313`

## XI_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

即使打了胜仗，我们的士兵也是受害者，他们的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]双手被你们肮脏的[Root.GetBloodType]污染了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:303`

### English

Even in victory our soldiers are victims in this war, sullying their [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] hands with your [Root.GetBloodType].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:314`

## XI_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

这次冲突的起因就是众所周知的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]对暴力的渴求。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:304`

### English

This conflict is a typical result of the well-known [From.GetSpeciesAdj] lust for violence.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:315`

## HM_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你挡住了[Root.GetName]的路。不管你想说什么，我们前进的步伐都无法阻挡。这一点，你自己最好想明白。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:306`

### English

You stand in the way of the [Root.GetName]. Whatever you wish to discuss, reconcile yourselves with the inevitability of our advance.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:317`

## HM_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

除了[Root.GetName]以外的生命都是次等的，但是那些卑鄙的[From.GetName]应该排在第三等。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:307`

### English

The lives of all outside the [Root.GetName] are secondary, but those of the vile [From.GetName] are tertiary.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:318`

## HM_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的集体主义只不过是个谎言。随着时间的推移，你们就会暴露出混乱不合的本质。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:308`

### English

Your collective is a lie. With time, you will reveal yourselves as a confused mass of discord.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:319`

## HM_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的社会是一个很好的例子，它能让星系里的其他物种都看到，将文明分割为个体是如何摧毁所有发展的希望的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:309`

### English

Your society serves as an example to the rest of the galaxy on how splintering a civilization into individuals destroys all hope of progress.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:320`

## HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是[Root.GetName]。注意你的言辞，你面对的是我们所有人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:310`

### English

We are the [Root.GetName]. Choose your words carefully, you stand before us all.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:321`

## HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们希望你可以代表所有[From.GetName]，正如我们这艘船能够代表整个[Root.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:311`

### English

We can only hope that you speak for all of the [From.GetName], as this vessel is the voice of every member of the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:322`

## HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你已经走上了通往团结的道路，但是你们准备好像我们一样奉献出自己了吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:312`

### English

You have taken steps on the journey to unity, but are you prepared to devote yourself as we have?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:323`

## HM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们能听到你们的人群中回荡着刺耳的声响，这种[From.GetSpeciesName]意识中的不和谐之处。你们怎么能容忍它存在？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:313`

### English

We can hear the cacophony of voices echoing beyond yours, this dissonance in the [From.GetSpeciesName] consciousness. How can you bear it?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:324`

## HM_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在已知的历史中从未发生过内斗。我们希望你们不会把这种事情来到我们这。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:314`

### English

We have not known conflict amongst ourselves for eons. We hope you will never bring it to us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:325`

## HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]向你们问候，[From.GetRulerTitle]。尽管你们不是我们的一份子，但是我们是很珍惜朋友的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:315`

### English

The [Root.GetName] greets you, [From.GetRulerTitle]. Although you are not part of us, you will come to know that we value our friends as well.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:326`

## HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们很乐意把你们当做[Root.GetName]的荣誉成员，加入这个叫做“联盟”的尽管不完美但却很重要的和谐之中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:316`

### English

We like to think of you as honorary members of the [Root.GetName], living in the imperfect but important harmony known as "alliance."

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:327`

## HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]和[Root.GetName]会向世人证明，两个追求内部一致的文明也可以和平共处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:317`

### English

The [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] will act as proof that societies striving for internal unanimity will coexist peacefully.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:328`

## HM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管你们内部一直很注重“个人”独立，但我们还是非常信任作为一个整体的[From.GetName]的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:318`

### English

Despite your relentless focus on your internal division into "persons," we are confident in our trust in the [From.GetName] as a whole.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:329`

## HM_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

所有阻碍[Root.GetAdj]的事物都必须清除。作为一个单独但有完整功能的智慧个体，你可以选择不成为阻碍。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:319`

### English

All obstacles to the [Root.GetAdj] must be eliminated. As beings of singular but functional sapience, you have the choice not to be an obstacle.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:330`

## HM_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是[Root.GetName]。关掉你们的护盾，交出舰船。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:320`

### English

We are the [Root.GetName]. Lower your shields and surrender your ships.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:331`

## HM_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们给你们带来的死亡不过是个体的死亡，而你们给我们带来的却是失去了整体的一部分。你们能像我们那样感受死亡吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:321`

### English

While each death we inflict upon you is a lonely life lost, each one you inflict upon us cuts away part of our being. Can you feel yourselves dying as we can?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:332`

## HM_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

一群各怀异志的低等生物永远无法打败始终团结如一的[Root.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:322`

### English

A horde of lower creatures with separate wills will never defeat the indivisible determination of the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:333`

## BW_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]像到处感染一样。要是没人管管，你们能把恒星的光都全部憋死。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:324`

### English

You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] spread like invasive growth. Left unchecked, you will choke the light of the stars.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:336`

## BW_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们清楚你们什么德行……予取予求贪得无厌，所到之处一片荒芜。我们这里容不下你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:325`

### English

We understand your kind... Taking, consuming, leaving only silence. You will find no shelter with us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:337`

## BW_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

陈旧腐朽必须为万象更新让步。这就是荒野之道。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:326`

### English

The old must wither so the new may rise. Such is the way of the wild.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:338`

## BW_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]弱小又不团结，终日疲于奔命。要么接受我们的荫蔽，要么就被风暴吞噬把。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:327`

### English

You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are small. Separated. Struggling. Come beneath our canopy, or be swallowed by the storm.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:339`

## BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

最不足道的微风也能吹动树叶。说话吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:328`

### English

Even the smallest breeze sound may stir the leaves. Speak.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:340`

## BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在生长、生存。你有什么要说的？我们听着呢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:329`

### English

We grow. We endure. We listen. What have you to say?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:341`

## BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

有一阵陌生的风把你们吹来了。那么你们是来滋养还是来枯萎的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:330`

### English

The scent of unfamiliar winds arrives with you. But have you come to nourish, or to wither?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:342`

## BW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们众口不一。这种不和谐相当怪异，但诉说着运动和变化的声音。我们打算倾听。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:331`

### English

Your voices are many. The discord is strange, yet it speaks of movement, of change. We are ready to listen.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:343`

## BW_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

火苗畏惧潮水，寒霜畏惧暖风。我们的处境远难过你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:332`

### English

The flame fears the flood, the frost dreads the thaw. We have survived worse than you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:344`

## BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

根结缠绕，水系交融。[From.GetName]虽然不是我们的一部分，但我们认识你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:333`

### English

Roots entwine, waters mingle. The [From.GetName] are not of us, yet we know you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:345`

## BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎光临我们枝芽荫蔽之处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:334`

### English

You are welcome here, in the shelter of our branches.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:346`

## BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

星系生机勃勃，让我们一起生长吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:335`

### English

The galaxy teems with life. Let us grow together.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:347`

## BW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

在虚空的无尽和声中，你们脱颖而出。我们愿给予阴翳和给养。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:336`

### English

Among the countless voices of the void, yours rings out. We offer you shade, and nourishment.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:348`

## BW_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:337`

### English

Fire scours the forest, but the roots remain.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:349`

## BW_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

比你们糟糕得多的东西我们已经见怪不怪了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:338`

### English

We have weathered worse than you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:350`

## BW_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

吃撑了的猎食者可活不过一季。趁为时不晚，最好长点心吧，[From.GetSpeciesName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:339`

### English

A predator that overfeeds does not survive the season. Remember this, [From.GetSpeciesName], while you still can.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:351`

## BW_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ABW_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

## MF_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你居然曾经离开过[From.GetHomeWorldName]，这真是让人吃惊不已，因为你们那里的人都病态地不愿接受或是不能接受其他物种。后代们会铭记[From.GetName]在[From.GetRulerName]统治下的黑暗岁月。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:381`

### English

It's surprising you ever made it off [From.GetHomeWorldName], so pathologically unable or unwilling to accept others. Future generations will remember the dark era of the [From.GetName] under [From.GetRulerName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:395`

## MF_HOSTILE_GREETING_01_NOMAD

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_HOSTILE_GREETING_01_NOMAD&lang=en)

### 中文

令人惊讶的是，那些将群星视为家园的生命，竟如此难以接纳与他们共享这片星空的存在。后世将会铭记在[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]统治下[From.GetName]的黑暗时代。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:382`

### English

Surprising that beings who claim the stars themselves as home remain so unable to accept those they share them with. Future generations will remember the dark era of the [From.GetName] under [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:396`

## MF_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不会让[From.GetSpeciesAdj]物种承受你们所采取的毁灭性政策的。[From.GetRulerName]统治者的无情足以表明[From.GetName]被你们物种中最歹毒的人统治着。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:383`

### English

We will not burden the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race with the destructive policies you have adopted. The failure of empathy in [From.GetRulerName]'s administration is only a sign that the [From.GetName] is ruled by the worst among your people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:397`

## MF_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们到底是为了“保护”你们文化中的哪一部分不受我们的侵害？你们的价值观里充斥着毫无缘由的畏惧和憎恨，这样的东西丢掉也罢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:384`

### English

What part of your culture do you think you are "protecting" against us? Between the irrational hatred and fear that permeate your values, it doesn't seem like there is much to lose.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:398`

## MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文
