### English

The more used [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] get to each other, the easier it will be for us to put our differences aside.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:399`

## MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.Capital.GetName]是一颗美丽的星球。我们的[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]一直在打听相关信息。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:386`

### English

[From.Capital.GetName] is a beauty to behold. Our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] are always asking about it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:400`

## MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们中的一些人好像很厌恶其他物种的来访者。当然了，如何处理这种狭隘的思想肯定是对你们政府的挑战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:387`

### English

Some of your people seem adverse to visitors from other species. Certainly, addressing this close-mindedness must be a challenging task for your administration.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:401`

## MF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesName]文化的开放性显示出你们已经迈出了很多人都不敢迈出的那一步，那是抛却了恐惧和偏见并向未知踏出的第一步。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:388`

### English

The openness of the [From.GetSpeciesName] culture shows that you have taken the leap that many dare not, to shed the fear and prejudice overshadowing the first steps into the unknown.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:402`

## MF_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们希望[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]公民是你们未来的星系宏伟计划里的一部分。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:389`

### English

We hope [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] citizens are part of your grand plans for the future of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:403`

## MF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们预见了[From.GetSpeciesAdj]和我们的美好未来。除此之外我们不愿与任何人为邻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:390`

### English

We see a bright future for the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people and ours. There are none we would rather live beside.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:404`

## MF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

这次会谈让我满怀希望。想象一下[From.GetSpeciesAdj][From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]通力合作所能达成的成就。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:391`

### English

These conversations make me hopeful. Imagine what [From.GetSpeciesAdj] [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] and [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will be able to achieve, having grown up playing together.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:405`

## MF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

可怜的[From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment]，你一定遇到过许多不能明白你的人民美丽之处的人。我们即将踏上的旅程既艰险又奇妙，很荣幸能与你一道。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:392`

### English

Poor [From.GetSpeciesNameCompliment], you must have met so many beings who didn't understand the beauty of your people. This journey we are on is as harsh as it is wondrous, and we are fortunate to get to make it with you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:406`

## MF_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

战争不仅是暴行，还是一个大麻烦。谁赢了并不重要；一旦开始，你就已经输了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:393`

### English

War is not only an atrocity, but an embarrassment. Who wins matters not; once you start, you have already failed.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:407`

## MF_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

看看这是谁，意识到自己不是对手，这会又想起来进行商谈了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:394`

### English

Look who decided to try talking, after proving that they couldn't.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:408`

## MF_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

这次冲突可能会在很多代的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之间播下互不信任的种子。这样的损失真的值得吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:395`

### English

This conflict may sow seeds of mistrust between the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] for generations. What could possibly be worth that loss?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:409`

## MF_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

要不是你们任由你们的文化怪癖摧毁我们之间和平共处的机会，我们本会像对待勇士一样敬重你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:396`

### English

We would have respected you as warriors, had you not chosen to let this cultural quirk destroy our chance at a time of peaceful coexistence.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:410`

## EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

审判降临汝身之日愈来愈近。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:398`

### English

The day when judgment will be passed on you grows ever closer.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:412`

## EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

很快，你们舰船发出的所有讯息都会被阻断。你们无人可以脱罪。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:399`

### English

Soon, communications from all your vessels will be blocked. None of you are free of sin.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:413`

## EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们用花言巧语的[From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]和虚假的承诺使人民远离真相。无以名状的惩戒等待着你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:400`

### English

You lead people away from the truth with sweetened [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound] and promises of false spiritual rewards. The punishment that awaits for your kind cannot be spoken aloud.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:414`

## EZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们明知故犯，抛弃真理，选择了贪求物质财富、罪孽行为和禁忌的知识。你们没有希望了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:401`

### English

You have knowingly rejected the truth and elected to gorge yourselves on material wealth, sinful deeds and forbidden knowledge. There can be no hope for your kind.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:415`

## EZ_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

上天注定了你弱我强。向你们展示正道是我们的责任。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:402`

### English

Providence has conspired to make you weak and us strong. It is our duty to firmly show you the right path.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:416`

## EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们还有时间选择回归正道。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:403`

### English

There is time for you yet to turn to the right path.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:417`

## EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们知道整个星系充斥着谎言，但我们会让真相遍及天下。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:404`

### English

We have found many lies throughout the galaxy, but we will ensure that the truth is also omnipresent.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:418`

## EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们已误入歧途。错误的信念比无知更加危险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:405`

### English

You have been lead astray. A wrongful conviction can be more dangerous than ignorance.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:419`

## EZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们把思想依附于物质上了。只要你们还相信自身是由神经和肉体组成，你们的精神就永远无法获得自由。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:406`

### English

Your minds have affixed themselves to the material plane. As long as you believe yourselves to be nothing but neurons and flesh, your minds will never be free.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:420`

## EZ_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们掌握的力量可以操纵行星间的火焰和星尘，但你们绝无可能永恒与不朽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:407`

### English

The power you hold is over the fire and dust of stars. It holds no sway over the eternal and immortal beyond them.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:421`

## EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

正如你们幸运地遇到了发现宇宙真相的人，我们也有幸将一个和蔼可亲的文明从厄运中拯救出来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:408`

### English

Just as you are fortunate to have met the people who discovered the truth about the universe, we consider ourselves fortunate to be saving such an amiable civilization from certain doom.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:422`

## EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们收到那好消息没有？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:409`

### English

Have you heard the good news?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:423`

## EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们有些学者认为[From.GetName]和[Root.GetName]信仰的是同一个真相，只是语言不同，表达方式不同。我们希望你们能及时接受我们的指正。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:410`

### English

Some of our scholars suggest that the faiths [From.GetName] and the [Root.GetName] are the same one truth, distinguished only by differences in language and interpretation. We hope you will accept our corrections in due time.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:424`

## EZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然你们毫无信仰，但我们不会放弃你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:411`

### English

Despite your faithlessness, we will never give up on you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:425`

## EZ_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们拿着武器对抗真理的先知。你们是在与宇宙本身开战。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:412`

### English

You have taken up arms against the prophets of the truth. You are at war with the universe itself.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:426`

## EZ_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是不会停下来的，除非全星系的每一个精神上的谎言都被抹消殆尽。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:413`

### English

We will not rest until every spiritual falsehood is eradicated from the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:427`

## EZ_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetRulerTitle]会保护我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:414`

### English

The [Root.GetRulerTitle] Protects.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:428`

## EZ_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

在终结之前，你们将诚心接受真相，但那已为时太晚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:415`

### English

You will accept the truth in your heart before the end, but by then it will be too late.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:429`

## FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

对于我们厌弃的一方不存在谈判的余地。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:417`

### English

There can be no negotiation with abominations.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:431`

## FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的报告显示你们已经研发出了能够理解外星语言的翻译器。我们还没有。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:418`

### English

Our reports suggest you have developed translators to understand alien languages. We haven't.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:432`

## FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的思想在追求[From.GetSpeciesAdj]物种进化和存在的合理性时犹豫踟蹰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:419`

### English

The mind boggles at the rationalizations you must make for the evolution and continued existence of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] race.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:433`

## FP_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的学者已经得出结论，[From.GetSpeciesName]的存在价值就是用来展示一个物种能堕落得多么五花八门。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:420`

### English

Our scholars have concluded that the purpose of the [From.GetSpeciesName] was to serve as an example of one of the many ways a species can be depraved.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:434`

## FP_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管你们拥有力量，但这黑暗的力量也不被允许散布。宇宙本身会将清除你们的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:421`

### English

Despite your power, the forces of darkness will not be allowed to prevail. The universe itself will purge you from existence.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:435`

## FP_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

没有必要害怕。你们物种的毁灭只是成为更伟大之物的一部分。驱使你们抵抗的生存欲将会在本应存在的生命形式中坚存下去。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:422`

### English

There is no need to be afraid. The destruction of your species is part of something greater, and the will to live, which compels you to resist, will persist through lifeforms who were meant to exist.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:436`

## FP_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

立刻投降吧，你们所有的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]将会被仁慈地屠杀，而不是被用于研究新武器对于[From.GetSpeciesAdj]生理的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:423`

### English

Surrender now and all of your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will be mercifully slaughtered rather than used to study the effects of new weaponry on [From.GetSpeciesAdj] physiology.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:437`

## FP_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

每一个[From.GetSpeciesName]都必须被消灭。这是我们庄严的使命。想到一个没有[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]的世界我们就不由狂喜。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:424`

### English

You must be destroyed to the last [From.GetSpeciesName]. This is our solemn duty, carried out with joy at the thought of a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-free existence.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:438`

## FP_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

每终结一条[From.GetSpeciesAdj]生命，每扼杀一个尚未出生的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnName]，星系中的每一颗星都会更闪耀一些。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:425`

### English

For each [From.GetSpeciesAdj] life that ends, for each [From.GetSpeciesSpawnName] that perishes before its birth, every star in the galaxy shines a little brighter.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:439`

## FP_WAR_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_WAR_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

这场战争将会带来一个和平、公正、道德、文明、欢愉、天伦的时代，并抹去其他的所有的生命形式。

## DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:459`

### English

## DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetAdj]的人民投票选举对民主价值观不屑一顾的[From.GetRulerName]为[From.GetRulerTitle]，你们怎么还有脸面自称民主？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:460`

### English

How can you call yourselves a true democracy when the [From.GetAdj] people have voted to elect [From.GetRulerName] as [From.GetRulerTitle], who spits in the face of democratic values?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:474`

## DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

如果抵抗尚未颠覆[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]的霸权，其实也为期不远了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:461`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:475`

## DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_HOSTILE_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

有朝一日，[From.GetSpeciesName]会逃出牢笼，像伟大的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]一般呼啸着冲上自由的天空，但若是被[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult][From.GetRulerTitle]统治着，那一天是不会到来的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:462`

### English

One day the [From.GetSpeciesName] will be uncaged and soar the skies of liberty like majestic [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment], but not while they are pinioned by a [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] [From.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:476`

## DC_HOSTILE_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_HOSTILE_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的物种永远不会明白民主的概念，但我们将会让你们亲身体会到战争的含义。

### English

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:477`

## DC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

### 中文

We can have some patience with lesser tyrants, but not much.

## DC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们在原则上会试着去理解双方的不同之处，但对你们不会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:465`

### English

## DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

## DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesAdj]人民的权益于我们而言有着至高无上的重要性。[From.GetAdj]帝国的权威排在第二位。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:467`

### English

The rights of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people are of paramount importance to us. The authority of the [From.GetAdj] government is a secondary concern.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:481`

## DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的人民有发言权，[From.GetRulerTitle]，但他们有自由吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:468`

### English

Your people have a say, [From.GetRulerTitle], but do they have liberty?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:482`

## DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你要是觉得你比你的人民还了解他们的权利的话，[From.GetRulerTitle]，那你还真是对人民的权利一无所知。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:469`

### English

If you think you know your people's rights better than they do, [From.GetRulerTitle], you know nothing about rights or people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:483`

## DC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

我们发现你们的群体思维很有趣，想要深入了解下你们的观点，你们对“民主”和“自由”这些高级社会概念有何见解？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:470`

### English

Our people find your group mind intriguing and would like to know more about your perspective. What is your understanding of advanced social concepts like democracy and liberty?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:484`

## DC_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们残暴的扩张主义并非无人知晓。我们已经起草了一份正式的外交控诉文书，不过我们还在斟酌精确的措辞。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:471`

### English

Your despotic expansionism has not gone unnoticed. We have been drafting a formal diplomatic complaint, but we are trying to be precise in how we word it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:485`

## DC_THREATENED_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_THREATENED_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们彼此之间有些分歧，但我们仍希望两个帝国可以在星系中和平共处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:472`

### English

We are different, yes, but we still hope there is a way for both of our empires to coexist peacefully in this galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:486`

## DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetAdj]人民选了个你这样的[From.GetRulerTitle]，还真是选对人了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:473`

### English

The [From.GetAdj] people have done themselves a great favor electing a [From.GetRulerTitle] such as you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:487`

## DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

自由之风即将吹遍星系，你我的国家都幸运地成为了第一批享受到的社会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:474`

### English

The winds of freedom are sweeping the galaxy. Our people and yours are fortunate to be among the first to enjoy them.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:488`

## DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们看得出你们还没准备好改革，但我们赞赏你们为地区安定做出的努力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:475`

### English

We can see you're not ready to discuss reforms yet, but we appreciate your contribution to regional stability.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:489`

## DC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然在真正的民主社会中，意见分歧和争论都是必然会出现的情况，但是我们承认更精简的决策制定过程有不少的好处，我们很佩服你们的高效率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:476`

### English

Though dissent and discourse are a must in any truly democratic society, we recognize the benefits of a more streamlined decision-making process. We admire your efficiency.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:490`

## DC_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们会给你们自由，或者死亡。自己选吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:477`

### English

We will give you liberty or give you death. Your choice.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:491`

## DC_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们也许能带走我们的生命，但永远带不走我们的道德优越感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:478`

### English

You may take our lives, but you will never take our smug sense of moral superiority.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:492`

## DC_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

民主国家不会互相征伐。在[From.GetRulerName]的政体下，人民没有真正意义上的民主。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:479`

### English

Democracies do not wage war against each other. [From.GetRulerName]'s regime cannot be considered truly democratic.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:493`

## DC_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的枷锁被打破之时，将会被铭记为我们的胜利之日。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:480`

### English

The day of our victory will be remembered as the day the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]'s chains were broken.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:494`

## DC_WAR_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_WAR_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

准备轨道解放。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:481`

### English

Prepare for orbital liberation.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:495`

## SD_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的体格显然是为体力劳动而生的。你们建立一个星际文明有什么意义？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:483`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] physique is clearly built for manual labor. What business do you have running an interstellar civilization?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:497`

## SD_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesAdj][From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]的苗条体型很适合在我们矿井的窄缝中作业。我正在考虑这个。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:484`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesAdj] [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] are perfectly sized for some of the slimmer crevices in our mines. And I think about this.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:498`

## SD_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

可怜的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]躲藏在道德疑虑之后，弱到无法掌控任何生物！你们到底是来宣扬废除死刑的还是纯粹来惹我们生气？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:485`

### English

Wretched [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult], too weak to be the master of any creature, hiding behind you moral qualms! Do you come to preach abolition or merely to annoy us?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:499`

## SD_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

没完没了的废话，没完没了的[From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]。等我们把所有的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都变作奴隶，你们就无法阻止我们让那些[From.GetSpeciesMouthName]闭嘴了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:486`

### English

Endless talk, endless [From.GetRandomSpeciesSound]. When we have enslaved all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will have a hard time convincing us not to put a drastic end to the noise from those [From.GetSpeciesMouthName]s.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:500`

## SD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

这事对我们有什么好处？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:487`

### English

Is there something in this for us?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:501`

## SD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们是要谈判，还是要交易？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:488`

### English

Are you here to negotiate, or to trade?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:502`

## SD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们是来发表关于人生价值的长篇大论，还是来跟我们谈判的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:489`

### English

Are you here to deliver some lecture on the value of life, or can we get on with the negotiations?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:503`

## SD_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们听到的关于我们的传言不过是逃亡奴隶口中的恶意中伤。我们欣赏你们的成就和你们的人民。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:490`

### English

Whatever you have heard about us is only backhanded slander from escaped servants. We admire your successes and your people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:504`

## SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetRulerName]，我们最爱的[From.GetRulerTitle]。我们向你们保证，你们看到的每一个被当做商品出售的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都是罪犯，或是你们社会应该除去的害虫。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:491`

### English

[From.GetRulerName], our favorite [From.GetRulerTitle]. Rest assured that any [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] you may have seen for sale here are criminals and other vermin your society is better off without.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:505`

## SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

高贵的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]以他们的莅临褒奖我们！相比于卑躬屈膝于相比其他低等物种的使者这是很好的转变。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:492`

### English

The noble [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] grace us with their presence! A nice change of pace from the groveling emissaries from lesser species.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:506`

## SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎，[From.GetRulerTitle]。愿你永远领导你们的次等物种。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:493`

### English

Greetings, [From.GetRulerTitle]. May you always remain a master of your lessers.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:507`

## SD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们为上次你们来访时我方商人试图购买[From.GetHeirTitle][From.GetHeirName]一事向你们致以诚挚的歉意。我们保证以后绝不会发生这种事了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:494`

### English

We apologize most deeply for one of our traders attempting to purchase [From.GetHeirTitle] [From.GetHeirName] on your last visit. We promise it will never happen again.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:508`

## SD_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]很快就会成为我们土地上劳作的又一位无名无姓的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:495`

### English

[From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName] will soon be just another [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] toiling in our fields without a title or a name.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:509`

## SD_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

作为对你傲慢的惩罚，你将被驱使一生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:496`

### English

You will pay for your insolence with a lifetime of servitude.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:510`

## SD_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

一等战争结束，[From.GetSpeciesAdj]就要被迫重建一切他们摧毁的东西。而[From.Capital.GetName]则会化为废墟，以儆效尤。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:497`

### English

Once this war is over, [From.GetSpeciesAdj] hands will be forced to rebuild everything they have destroyed. [From.Capital.GetName] will be left in ruins as an example.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:511`

## DH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

真是随便去干点别的什么，都比听你说话有趣啊。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:499`

### English

I can think of so many things I'd rather be doing than listening to you right now.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:513`

## DH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你是[From.GetName]的[From.GetRulerTitle]还是下等的仆从？你们这些人我根本分不清呢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:500`

### English

Are you the [From.GetRulerTitle] of the [From.GetName] or a lowly servant? I can't even tell with you people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:514`

## DH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

对你们的讨伐并非我方当前要务，但我们保证总有一天会来料理你们的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:501`

### English

Your subjugation is not a priority, but we'll make sure you assume your rightful place eventually.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:515`

## DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，你们好。有什么有意思的提案吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:502`

### English

Ah, greetings. Do you have anything interesting to offer?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:516`

## DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

抱歉，我刚刚走神了。你找我们有什么事？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:503`

### English

Sorry, my mind wandered there for a moment. What business do you have with us?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:517`

## DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

多么令人惊讶的外表！我希望你们不要介意我询问，但是你们是否愿意以合理的代价将[From.GetSpeciesAdj]不可接触者卖出呢？我非要，就是简单地“非要”一个在家里。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:504`

### English

What an intriguing appearance! I hope you don't mind me asking, but you wouldn't be willing to part with some of your [From.GetSpeciesAdj] undesirables for a reasonable price? I must, simply *must* have one at home.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:518`

## DH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

劳苦的工作都是你们自己来干？一定很累吧。你心里肯定有些嫉妒我们才对。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:505`

### English

You do all hard work yourselves? It must be exhausting. Surely you're at least a bit jealous of us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:519`

## DH_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

向你们保证，我们并不介意你们在其他前线的扩张，但如果你们的欲望过快膨胀的话，我们会密切关注的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:506`

### English

Rest assured, we are not troubled by your expansion on other fronts, but if you need anything, anything at all, we'll see to it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:520`

## DH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

尊贵的客人啊，有什么我们能做到的，都会尽量做到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:507`

### English

Most valued guest, any favor we can do you or have done on our behalf, we will try to arrange for.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:521`

## DH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎！[Root.Capital.GetName]是象征奢华与舒适的灯塔，我们也非常高兴能与朋友们分享此等伟业。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:508`

### English

Welcome! [Root.Capital.GetName] is a beacon of opulence and comfort, and we gladly offer our friends a taste of what we have achieved.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:522`

## DH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

非常荣幸。今日我们能为您提供什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:509`

### English

Always a pleasure. What or who may we offer you today?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:523`

## DH_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

一想到[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]会在我们的胜利宴会上端茶送水，我就发自内心的想笑啊。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:510`

### English

The thought of "[From.GetRulerTitle]" [From.GetRulerName] serving dessert at our victory banquet already makes me laugh heartily.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:524`

## DH_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们将会为这场战争付出代价，世世为奴。[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]从出生到长大都不会尝到自由的滋味，连他们的祖先不会知道[From.GetName]的存在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:511`

### English

Your generation will repay us for this war with a lifetime of serfdom. Your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] will grow up never knowing freedom, and their ancestors will never even know there was such a thing as the [From.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:525`

## DH_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

能有这个深入了解你们的机会，必须向你们致以感谢。我们从来不知道把煮熟的[From.GetSpeciesAdj]肉塞进[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]里会这么美味呢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:512`

### English

We must thank you for this opportunity to get to know you a bit better. We had never thought that boiling [From.GetSpeciesAdj] flesh stuffed in a [From.GetSpeciesOrganName] would produce such a luscious taste experience.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:526`

## EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的价值观和选择完全不合逻辑，我们也根本无法展开有建设性的谈话。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:514`

### English

Your values and choices are not grounded in logic, which is why we cannot have a constructive conversation about them.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:528`

## EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

就是你们物种所受到的进化压力让[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的大脑不够发达。这是科学。自己去查吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:515`

### English

The evolutionary pressures your species endured have left [From.GetSpeciesAdj] brains simply less developed. It's science. Look it up.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:529`

## EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们凭空捏造出信仰来填补空洞的心灵，你们永远无法体会到智力获得启蒙带来的真正欢愉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:516`

### English

You invented your faith to fill empty minds. Your people will never feel the true euphoria of an enlightened intellect.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:530`

## EE_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们无法内省自己的思想，这是头脑简单的动物社会具有的标志。你们毫无值得学习之处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:517`

### English

Your failure to critically examine your ideas is the hallmark of a society of simple-minded herd animals. We have nothing to learn from you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:531`

## EE_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的文明止步不前，是因为你们内部文化拒绝进步。这是铁一般事实。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:518`

### English

The poor state of development in your civilization is due to an inferior culture which discourages progress. It's a fact.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:532`

## EE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们带着问题来的，还是答案？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:519`

### English

Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Do you come with questions, or with answers?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:533`

## EE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的目标不是力量而是知识，尽管有些时候两者是一回事。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:520`

### English

Our goal is not power, but knowledge, although they can sometimes be the same.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:534`

## EE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

当你们听说你们的信仰相当不合理性可能会感到震惊。但如果你们想与我们交流的话，最好学会面对残酷的现实吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:521`

### English

It may surprise you to hear that your beliefs are quite irrational. You had better get used to harsh truths if you want to converse with us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:535`

## EE_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

不管你们接下来有什么计划，都请记住我们对你们没有威胁。我们满足于探索新领域，而不是去挑战你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:522`

### English

Whatever you're planning next, remember that we present no threat to you. We are content to discover new frontiers, not challenge yours.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:536`

## EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们通力合作，定能揭开这个星系的奥秘。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:523`

### English

Together, we will unveil the secrets of the galaxy.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:537`

## EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的头脑和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的头脑可谓是互相补足。我们联合起来的智慧成就肯定比分开的要大。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:524`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] mind and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind complement each other. Our intellectual efforts will be greater than the sum of their parts.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:538`

## EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

能够见到其他心怀好奇又聪慧的物种，甚感欣慰。有太多人情愿让奥秘掩埋在无尽的深空中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:525`

### English

It's a joy to meet another curious and intellectual people. Too many prefer to let the mysteries found in the depths of space remain mysteries.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:539`

## EE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetAllianceName]的发现可谓代表了智能生物所能触碰到的终极前沿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:526`

### English

The findings of the [Root.GetAllianceName] will represent the ultimate frontier of discoveries by sapient beings.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:540`

## EE_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

拥有关于[From.Capital.GetName]是如何掩埋在废墟中的详尽记录能为我们的考古学家省去大量麻烦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:527`

### English

It will save our archaeologists a lot of trouble having detailed logs on how [From.Capital.GetName] was left in ruins.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:541`

## EE_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们做出选择的武器是智慧，并由理智和理性砥砺。你们觉得自己还有机会吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:528`

### English

Our weapon of choice is our intellects, sharpened by reason and rationalism. Do you like your odds, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:542`

## EE_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

不管你们想象中会有哪路大神来帮你们赢得这场战争，就敬请祈祷吧。合十的双手可是握不住武器的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:529`

### English

Whatever figments of your imagination you are hoping to intervene in this conflict, please pray as much as you like. Clasped hands hold no weapons.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:543`

## SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetAdj]人身上似乎带着不愉快的气息啊。你们有没有想过你们做过什么事导致了这个？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:531`

### English

[From.GetAdj] people emit an aura of unpleasantness. Have you considered what you might have done to bring this upon yourselves?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:545`

## SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不想和毫无精神上的纯洁的人扯上关系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:532`

### English

We'd rather not associate with people of such poor spiritual hygiene.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:546`

## SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

全星系的灵魂都能感知到你们邪恶的念头。别以为可以在我们面前藏起你们的恶毒之心。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:533`

### English

Your ill intentions can be felt through the soul of the galaxy. Do not think you can hide your wickedness from us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:547`

## SS_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们执着于可以测量、学习的东西，却忽视了宇宙的内涵，你们的浅薄将会割裂你们与其他生命的联系。你们怎么能对我们做这种事？你们怎么能对你们自己做这种事？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:534`

### English

You cling to what you can measure and study, neglecting the depths of the universe, and your shallowness is tearing at your connection to other beings. How can you do this to us? How can you do this to yourselves?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:548`

## SS_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

届时你们会理解宇宙的真谛的，弱者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:535`

### English

You will grow conscious of the truth about the universe in due time, fragile ones.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:549`

## SS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好，[From.GetName]。我们在宇宙中感受到了你们的存在，但还没有确定你们在这广阔舞台所扮演的角色。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:536`

### English

Well met, [From.GetName]. We have felt your presence in the universe, but have yet to determine your role in the grand events.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:550`

## SS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesName]，[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们都是拼图的碎片罢了，这个拼图，需要我们之中最伟大的头脑才能解答。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:537`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesName], [Root.GetSpeciesName], we are all pieces of a puzzle, the puzzle, that calls to the greatest minds among us all to solve it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:551`

## SS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们是否相信你们在宇宙扮演的角色无关紧要，我们会试着揭示它的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:538`

### English

Whether you believe in your role in the universe is irrelevant. We will seek to unveil it regardless.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:552`

## SS_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

同为生命，不必互相残杀。只有仁慈才能为你们的力量赋予意义。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:539`

### English

There is no need for life to destroy other life. Only by being merciful can you give purpose to your strength.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:553`

## SS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们感觉得到[From.GetName]，离开我们的星球后终于在空茫冰冷的太空中感受到一丝温暖。现在，我们终于团结一心了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:540`

### English

We could sense the [From.GetName], this nexus of warmth in the cold void of space, long before we arrived. Now, we are finally united.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:554`

## SS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

在如此浩瀚的宇宙中，所有文明不过是宏伟织锦中的丝线，[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]能够交织在一起，实属难得的幸运。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:541`

### English

In a cosmos so vast, where entire civilizations are but threads in a greater weave, it is a rare fortune that the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName] have become intertwined.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:555`

## SS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesName]与绝大多数物种不同，与其内心的灵魂有着微妙的联系。你们的神妙之处可能正是生命之伟大奥妙的关键所在。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:542`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesName] are in touch with their inner beings like few species. Your magnificence may hold the key to the great mysteries of life.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:556`

## SS_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

每一次人们的相互攻击，都让生命的伟大织网损坏一点。让我们希望这次冲突不会持久吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:543`

### English

The great weave of life is unraveling with each assault a people makes on another. Let us hope this conflict is a short one.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:557`

## SS_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

每一次我们造成死亡，都会痛入心扉。请别逼我们这么做。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:544`

### English

We feel each death we cause. Don't make us do this.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:558`

## SS_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你的恶行不会消散，只会将你反噬。这就是你们人民受苦的原因。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:545`

### English

The evil you do does not dissipate, but will seek you out and return to its master. This is why your people suffer.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:559`

## SS_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

不管是胜利还是失败，你们还是空洞的存在。你们居然相信战斗只是物质层面的，可怜的笨蛋。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:546`

### English

Whether victory or defeat, yours will be hollow. You believe you fight this battle on the material plane alone, poor fools.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:560`

## HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHC_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

并不奇怪，[From.GetAdj]还没有像我们一样联合起来，毕竟为[From.GetRulerName]这种不明智的[From.GetRulerTitle]效劳会让人变得非常消极。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:548`

### English

It's unsurprising the [From.GetAdj] people have not united as we have, given how demotivating it must be to serve a [From.GetRulerTitle] as unwise as [From.GetRulerName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:562`

## HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHC_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你散布混乱和无序。[Root.GetAdj]人不想和你扯上关系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:549`

### English

You spread discord and disorder. The [Root.GetAdj] people want nothing to do with you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:563`

## HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHC_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

如果你一定要强迫你的子民遵你之命的话，那你和我们完全不同，[From.GetRulerTitle]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:550`

### English

If you must force your people to do your bidding, you have nothing in common with us, [From.GetRulerTitle].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:564`

## HC_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHC_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的动机一向自私。我们为什么还要期待[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]能有什么改变？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:551`

### English

## KK_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

### 中文

## KK_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

## MI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMI_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们就把话挑明吧。我们需要在周围构筑隔绝星系的缓冲带。而你不能成为那道缓冲，你的同盟也如是。唯有冰冷死寂的太空才是缓冲，如果没有的话，我们就自己创造一道出来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:595`

### English

Let us state this plainly. We demand a buffer between us and the rest of the galaxy. You are not that buffer. Your allies are not that buffer. Cold, dead space is that buffer, and if it is not, we will make it so.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:609`

## MI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMI_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

我们已无意继续进行交流。

### English

Aligning yourself against the oldest mind in the galaxy is not... wise.

## 01_MAKE_RIVAL_HIVE_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_MAKE_RIVAL_HIVE_FALLEN_EMPIRE_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

在我们无数的心声中，罕有众口一言的情况。但这一次我们出奇一致：我们憎恶你。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:644`

### English

Among our countless voices, rarely do we all agree. But in this, we are united: we loath you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:658`

## 01_MAKE_RIVAL_HIVE_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ACCEPT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_MAKE_RIVAL_HIVE_FALLEN_EMPIRE_ACCEPT&lang=en)

你似乎误以为你的态度对我们很重要。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:645`

### English

You seem to be under the impression that your disposition matters to us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:659`

## HW_VASSAL_GREETING_01

### 中文

[Root.GetName]之利剑听您调遣，[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:647`

### English

The sword of the [Root.GetName] is at your disposal, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].
