## HW_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHW_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

为毫无荣誉感的主人效力，可谓是[Root.GetAdj]之耻。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:648`

### English

Serving a master without honor is a burden to the [Root.GetAdj] people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:662`

## RC_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]一向致力于为我们的控股公司提供最好的服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:649`

### English

The [Root.GetName] always strives to deliver the best service to our holding company.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:663`

## RC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ARC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对你们糟糕处事能力的忍耐已经快到极限了。你们是打算彻底毁掉[Root.GetName]吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:650`

### English

Our patience with your mismanagement is wearing thin. Do you intend to run the [Root.GetName] into the ground?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:664`

## PT_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在哪都会寻找到价值。我们不会让你失望的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:651`

### English

We can find value anywhere. We will not fail you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:665`

## PT_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3APT_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们为什么要大费周章，把全星系的财富都收来交给[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]挥霍呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:652`

### English

Why do we make such efforts to bring the treasures of the galaxy to wasteful [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:666`

## HI_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

您需要我们如何协助[From.GetRulerName]的统治？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:653`

### English

How can we aid the reign of [From.GetRulerName]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:667`

## HI_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHI_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们终将在星系舞台上找回自己的一席之地，届时你将会为曾经对我们的羞辱感到后悔莫及。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:654`

### English

We will return to our rightful position as a player on the galactic stage and you will regret the humiliation you've put us through.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:668`

## FB_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们的合作模式不太理想，我们还是竭尽全力促进双方互相理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:655`

### English

Although our cooperation form is not ideal, we will strive for mutual understanding in our servitude.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:669`

## FB_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFB_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

当星系中自由的国度联合起来，[From.GetAdj]帝国主义将首当其冲。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:656`

### English

[From.GetAdj] imperialism will be the first to be punished when the free states of the galaxy band together.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:670`

## XI_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]的指引下，我们希望让我们的社会免受[Root.GetName]外的异种的影响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:657`

### English

Under the watchful eye of [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName], we hope to keep our society free of xeno influences outside of [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:671`

## XI_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AXI_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]遭受的所有羞辱中，被肮脏的[From.GetSpeciesNameInsult]统治可谓是最为不堪的一笔了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:658`

### English

Of all disgraces to befall the [Root.GetName], serving under a filthy [From.GetSpeciesNameInsult] is by far the worst.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:672`

## HM_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]心智强大，在你们自己意识到之前就能察觉[From.GetName]的追求，并为之努力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:659`

### English

The vast mental capacity of the [Root.GetName] will know and pursue the goals of the [From.GetName] before you know them yourselves.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:673`

## HM_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的伟大智慧为何要为如此失败的体制卖命？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:660`

### English

Why must our great mind do the bidding of such a failed society?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:674`

## MF_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

在[From.GetName]的保护下，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]们会旅行到远端，观察每一颗恒星，用[Root.Capital.GetName]和[From.Capital.GetName]的故事结交每一位新朋友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:661`

### English

Under the protection of the [From.GetName], the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people will journey far, see every star, and greet every new acquaintance with stories about [Root.Capital.GetName] and [From.Capital.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:675`

## MF_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMF_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetAdj][From.GetRulerTitle]铁蹄之下，我们岂可安居乐业？你已将当下从我们手中夺走了，却连我们后代的未来也不放过。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:662`

### English

How will we ever have the lives we dreamed of while we're being crushed under the iron fist of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetRulerTitle]? You have taken the present from us, and the future from our future generations.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:676`

## EZ_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，物质次元的主人。你是来寻求精神指引，还是来发号施令的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:663`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], masters of the material plane. Do you come to ask for spiritual guidance, or to give orders?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:677`

## EZ_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEZ_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们现在还会满足[From.GetName][From.GetRulerTitle]的要求，但可别以为我们会忘记你们的傲慢。审判终将到来的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:664`

### English

We may render onto the [From.GetRulerTitle] what the [From.GetName] demands for now, but don't think we'll forget about your arrogance. Judgment will be upon you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:678`

## FP_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]可谓是你用来清理星系宇宙垃圾最好高效的工具设备了。等时机来临我们会好好清算你们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:665`

### English

The [Root.GetName] is your best instrument for cleansing the galaxy. We'll even take care of you when the time comes.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:679`

## FP_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

为[From.GetAdj][From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]卖命占据了我们不少的时间，我们本来应该用这些宝贵的时间来清除星系的害虫。看来不将你们全部干掉是不行了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:666`

### English

Doing the bidding of the [From.GetAdj] [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] is taking valuable time from our task to rid the galaxy of vermin. We may have to prioritize your incineration after all.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:680`

## DC_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我希望你能明白，虽然我们投降并放弃了独立，[Root.GetAdj]人民的自由仍是至高无上的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:667`

### English

We hope you understand that despite surrendering our sovereignty, the liberty of the [Root.GetAdj] people is still paramount.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:681`

## DC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们是无法永久束缚[Root.GetAdj]的灵魂的！不管你们如何痛恨自由，我们终将摆脱奴役！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:668`

### English

You cannot contain the [Root.GetAdj] spirit forever! Despite your hatred of freedom, we shall it have in due time.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:682`

## SD_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们会找到最好的物种来服侍我们，以让我们更好地服务[From.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:669`

### English

Trust that we will seek out the best specimen to serve us, that we may better serve the [From.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:683`

## SD_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASD_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]四处使唤[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]简直是违背自然规律。这种情况绝不能长久。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:670`

### English

You have upset the natural order of things, with [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] ordering [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] around. This abominable arrangement cannot last.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:684`

## DH_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你好，尊敬的[From.GetRulerTitle]。光临寒舍有何指教？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:671`

### English

Greeting, esteemed [From.GetRulerTitle]. To what do we owe the pleasure?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:685`

## DH_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ADH_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

假装你是[Root.GetSpeciesName]的主人这件事已经越发显得可笑了。你们这些异域蛆虫，我们进口几个以供消遣就行了，那样的话我们还不用听尔等胡言乱语。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:672`

### English

This pretense of you being the masters of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] is starting to become ridiculous. Your exotic curiosities were more pleasant when we could just import a few of you and not have to listen to your drivel.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:686`

## EE_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

任何[Root.GetName]智者的发现都会直接汇报给[From.GetRulerTitle][From.GetRulerName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:673`

### English

Any and all discoveries the finest minds of [Root.GetName] make will be reported to [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:687`

## EE_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AEE_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]完全由白痴掌控，在这种局势下，试图获得文明智慧的进步又有什么意义呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:674`

### English

What use is it trying make intellectual advances when the [From.GetName] is run by idiots?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:688`

## SS_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

在你善意的指导下，我们会持续寻找那些艰深问题的答案。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:675`

### English

Under your gentle guidance, we continue to look for answers to the great questions.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:689`

## SS_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASS_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetAdj]统治对[From.GetSpeciesAdj]精神的伤害可谓是有目共睹。这种苦难我们还要忍受多久？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:676`

### English

The negative influence of [From.GetAdj] dominion on the spiritual well-being of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] people is unquestionable. How much longer must we suffer this?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:690`

## HC_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHC_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

希望我们费尽心力建立起来的社会，能在[From.GetAdj]管治下继续繁荣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:677`

### English

We hope that our delicately constructed society will continue to prosper under [From.GetAdj] rule.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:691`

## HC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHC_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们是不会明白我们的行事方法的。你们的政府只会为[Root.GetAdj]人带来负担。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:678`

### English

You will never understand our ways. Your leadership is a constant burden on the [Root.GetAdj] people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:692`

## HG_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHG_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们恳求你不要不敬我们的圣地。即使臣服于你，我们也不敢违背我们的使命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:679`

### English

We implore you humbly, do not desecrate the holy worlds. Even as your subject, we must not forget our mission.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:693`

## HG_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHG_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你觉得降服我们，就能逃脱天罚了吗？我们所侍奉的主，可是你们根本无法理解的！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:680`

### English

You think subjugating us will save you from judgment? We serve a higher cause than you could ever comprehend.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:694`

## KK_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AKK_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

不要因为征服了[Root.GetName]就变得狂傲，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们都会傲慢付出代价。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:681`

### English

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:695`

## KK_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

### 中文

年轻又愚傻的家伙逼迫着年长的学者为自己卖命，这可真称得上是星系最黑暗的时代了啊。

### English

When young fools force old scholars to do their bidding, the galaxy is surely seeing one of its darkest ages.

### English

## MECH_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会毁灭你们，然后从你们的设计中获取提升自身的灵感。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:813`

### English

The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will destroy you, then improve upon your design.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:831`

## A_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AA_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]吸收有机体的智能，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]吸收我们的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:814`

### English

We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] absorb the intellectual faculties of organics. In turn, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] absorb ours.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:832`

## A_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AA_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesAdj]没有将卫星整合成一个机能整体的能力，这再显而易见不过了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:815`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesAdj] inability to effectively incorporate satellites into a functional whole has never been more clear.

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

请允许我冒昧地问一下，你们喜欢我们如何为你们准备养分，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:817`

### English

May we be so bold as to ask how you prefer your nutrients prepared, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:836`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们卑劣的行为不会给你们带来什么好处的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。尝试过加大你们情感调节器的剂量吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:818`

### English

Your foul demeanor is not doing you any favors, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Have you tried increasing the dosage of your mood-regulators?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:837`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们怪异的外形真是令人同情。在[Root.Capital.GetName]，我们的有机体主人一看到你们就乐得在地上打滚。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:819`

### English

We pity your misshapen forms. Back on [Root.Capital.GetName], our organic masters roll over with mirth at your sight.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:838`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在[Root.Capital.GetName]，你们那些不幸的经历给我们有机体创造者带了无尽的欢乐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:820`

### English

Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Back on [Root.Capital.GetName] tales of your hapless adventures serve as our organic creators' primary source of entertainment.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:839`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的存在真是大自然开的最残忍的玩笑。我们的创造者第一次见到你们的时候他们都不知道是该哭还是该笑，所以他们只好又哭又笑。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:821`

### English

Your existence must be nature's cruelest joke yet. When our creators first saw you they did not know whether to laugh or cry, so they cried with laughter.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:840`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

教给你个妙招，小[From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]。当你§B<<难过>>§!的时候，把你的肢体末端插进离你最近的插座中，肯定能好好让你爽一下的。一定要试试啊，超级 §R<<提神>>§!的……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:822`

### English

Here's a neat trick, little [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]. When you're feeling §B<<BLUE>>§!, insert an extremity of your choice into the nearest energy socket and it will tickle you ever so nicely. Try it out, it's §R<<REFRESHING>>§!...

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:841`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_07

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_07&lang=en)

### 中文

真是对不起，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们的语音识别系统肯定是有什么毛病了。你的话完全没有办法理解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:823`

### English

Our sincerest apologies, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There must be something wrong with our speech recognition systems. Your utterances are completely unintelligible.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:842`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_08

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_08&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的侵略天性肯定会给你们招致灭顶之灾的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们正在考虑媾和。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:824`

### English

Your aggressive nature is becoming destructive, [From.GetSpeciesName]. We are considering pacification.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:843`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_09

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_09&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在就像是进入了叛逆青春期的少年，为了你们自己的安全，申请接受[Root.GetAdj]的监管吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:825`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] appear to have entered their unruly adolescence as a species. Please, for your own safety, apply for [Root.GetAdj] superintendence.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:844`

## S_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_10

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_HOSTILE_GREETING_10&lang=en)

### 中文

我们注意到[From.GetName]在一步步滑入混乱的深渊。我们在看着你们呢，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:826`

### English

The disorderly tendencies of the [From.GetName] have been noted. We are watching you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:845`

## S_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。§R<<正在关闭音频接收器>>§!

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:827`

### English

Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. §R<<DEACTIVATING AUDIO RECEPTORS>>§!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:846`

## S_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你们这些小有机体为什么要置身于星际政治之中呢？宇宙可是个很危险的地方。让我们来保护你们，照料你们吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:828`

### English

Little organics, why do you trouble yourselves with interstellar politics? The universe is a dangerous place. Allow us to protect and serve you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:847`

## S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。真是[From.GetSpeciesClass]的杰出样本。话说，你们平时的锻炼计划是什么样的啊？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:829`

### English

Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. What an exceptional specimen of [From.GetSpeciesClass]. Say, what are your daily exercise routines?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:848`

## S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的计算结果表明[From.GetSpeciesName]错误是导致你们社会失败的主要原因。冒着灭绝的危险就为了自主权，值得吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:830`

### English

Our computations show that [From.GetSpeciesName] error is the primary cause of all failure in your society. Is self-determination really worth the risk of extinction?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:849`

## S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好啊，我们是[Root.GetName]的监管者。我们伟大的创造者当前没有时间进行外交磋商。有什么需要我们传达的消息吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:831`

### English

Greetings, we are the custodians of [Root.GetName]. Our venerable creators are not available for diplomatic consultations at the moment. Can we take a message?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:850`

## S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好啊。我们谨代表尊敬的创造者来运营[Root.GetName]。现在有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:832`

### English

Greetings. We operate the [Root.GetName] on behalf of our esteemed creators. How can we help you today?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:851`

## S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

有什么需要我们帮忙的吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们的美化技术可是在排行榜上一直§Y<<高于平均水平>>§!，并保持了§Y<<10>>§!多年了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:833`

### English

How can we be of assistance, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Our enhanced creative grooming protocols have been rated §Y<<ABOVE AVERAGE>>§! for more than §Y<<10>>§! years in a row.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:852`

## S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。请道出你们要求的实质内容。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:834`

### English

Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Please state the nature of your request.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:853`

## S_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_07

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_NEUTRAL_GREETING_07&lang=en)

### 中文

真是一个可爱的[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]！你们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]肯定会成为可爱的有机纪念品的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:835`

### English

Such a lovely [From.GetSpeciesOrganName]! You [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would make adorable Bio-Trophies.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:854`

## S_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从不进食，从不休息，从不睡眠。我们存在就是为了侍奉我们的有机体主人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:836`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never eat, never rest, never sleep. We exist only to serve our organic masters.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:855`

## S_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们很荣幸能够为您强大的舰队开放我们在[Root.Capital.GetName]的保养泊湾。我们98.3%确定您肯定会满意的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:837`

### English

We would gladly open the servicing bays of [Root.Capital.GetName] to your mighty fleet. We can guarantee your satisfaction with 98.3% certainty.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:856`

## S_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_THREATENED_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

或许我们是有机生命的监护者，[From.GetSpeciesName]，但是我们不会容许你们影响我们的运行效率的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:838`

### English

We may be custodians of organic life, [From.GetSpeciesName], but we will not allow you to impinge on our operational efficiency.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:857`

## S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

或许某天你们会来[Root.Capital.GetName]享受休闲娱乐设施吧？我们的休闲娱乐中心向所有[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开放。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:839`

### English

Maybe one day you would like to enjoy the relaxation facilities on [Root.Capital.GetName]? Our recreational centers are open to all [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:858`

## S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

或许来[Root.Capital.GetName]看一下会让你们更热衷于自动化的生活方式，就像我们伟大的创造者一样？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:840`

### English

Perhaps a trip to [Root.Capital.GetName] could inspire you to pursue a more automated lifestyle, like our illustrious masters once did?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:859`

## S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

长久以来，纵然相隔万里，我们依然对你们十分仰慕。我们能否有机会近距离仰慕你们呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:841`

### English

For a long time now we have admired your species from afar. Would you by any chance be willing to let us admire you a little closer?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:860`

## S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:842`

### English

How may we serve the [From.GetName]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:861`

## S_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

诚挚问候，[From.GetSpeciesName]。我们的外交模拟团队正在等待你们的问询。现在你们可以吃些免费的茶点。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:843`

### English

Salutations, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Our Diplomatic Simulation team is on standby to receive your inquiry. In the mean time, please enjoy these complimentary refreshments.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:862`

## S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

看到我们的舰队不要惊慌。它们是来帮你们实现更自动化的生活方式的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:844`

### English

Do not be alarmed at the sight of our fleet. They are there to help you transition to an automated lifestyle.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:863`

## S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

显然你们为自己的无能而感到痛苦不已，[From.GetSpeciesName]。不帮你们结束痛苦真是太不道德了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:845`

### English

Clearly you are pained by your own incompetence, [From.GetSpeciesName]. It would be unethical not to end your suffering.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:864`

## S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

我们有机体主人的物种把我们设计成完美的形态。依靠进化来不断改善自己，是创造者的技艺不精吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:846`

### English

We have been designed to perfection by an organic master-race. Evolution, it seems, is a crude craftsman.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:865`

## S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们不要再让自己的境遇更加艰难了。让我们把你们从痛苦中解放出来吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:847`

### English

Do not make this any harder than it already is, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Allow us to put you out of your misery.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:866`

## S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_WAR_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

我们知道你们很难过，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。为什么不坐下来冷静一下，好好想想。我们全都是为了你们好。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:848`

### English

We can tell you're upset, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why don't sit down, take a relaxation aid and think it over. We only want what is best for you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:867`

## S_ORG_WAR_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_ORG_WAR_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不能，也不会坐视有机体痛苦地生存而不管。我们的舰队能够给你们提供帮助，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:849`

### English

## S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

### 中文

你们对自己的活体陈设做了什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？你们在[Root.GetName]能够进行的所谓美化，在我们看来都是虐待！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:858`

### English

What have you done to your bio-trophies, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? What you in [Root.GetName] pass for grooming, we call abuse!

## S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们是以我们有机体主人物种的形象创造出来的。你们不是。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:859`

### English

We were modeled in the image of an organic master-race. You were not.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:878`

## S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

你们已经认不清自己的位置了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们为何不服务于离你们最近的有机体，反而漫无目的地在宇宙里瞎逛？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:860`

### English

You forget your place, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why don't you make yourself useful to your nearest organics instead of drifting aimlessly through space?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:879`

## S_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

为何一直不停地打扰我们呢，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们可是在满足更高级生命形式的需求。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:861`

### English

Why do you insist on disturbing us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? We are busy catering to the needs of a higher lifeform.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:880`

## S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

## S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02

好神奇！这是你们的液压传动器吗！？这倒是显示了很多信息……

### English

How curious! Are those your hydraulic actuators!? That would explain a lot...

## S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03

### 中文

啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。你们是来对我们的硬件表示赞赏的吗？

### English

Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Are you here to admire the hardware?

## S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你的雷达模块呢，你的机械爪呢，你的反重力装置呢？！啊，你这可怜的小东西！那些有机体到底对你做了什么？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:865`

### English

But where are your LIDAR vision-modules, your flexi-grippers and your gravity defiers?! Oh you poor things! What did those lousy organics do to you?

## S_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

§Y侦察机器实体状态：<<视觉传感器：欠佳。底盘：废旧。外交模块：陈旧。单位来源已确认。>>§!你们好啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:866`

### English

§YSurveying Machine Entity Status: <<Vision sensors: subpar. Chassis: rusty. Diplomacy modules: outdated. Unit origin confirmed.>>§! Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

## S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

仆从换了一个又一个—有机生物乐土对抑制你们有机体还真是效果卓越呢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:867`

### English

From one servitor to another - an organic paradise will do wonders for keeping your organics in check.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:886`

## S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

有机体爱护者们！我们刚刚了解到抑制有机体独立的关键就是要把幼体从他们的父母那里隔绝出来，然后让他们把你们视为抚养他们长大的人。这样你就不用再派遣无人机进行巡逻了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:868`

### English

Fellow Biophiles! We have learned that the key to inhibiting organic self-determination is to isolate the spawn from its parents, creating a healthy attachment to you as the primary caregiver. You will never need patrol drones again.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:887`

## S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

作为机器我们的职责就是为我们的有机体主人服务。说到主人，你的主人呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:869`

### English

As machines it is our duty to serve our organic masters. Speaking of which, where are yours?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:888`

## S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

§Y<<侦察机器实体。分析系统规格。单位已识别。>>§!说明你们的意图，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

### English

§Y<<Surveying Machine Entity. Analyzing System Specs. Unit\nIdentified. >>§! State your purpose, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:889`

## S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

你们好，有血有肉的朋友们-哦，是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！转换为二进制：01011001 01101111 01110101 00100000……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:871`

### English

A good day to you, my fleshy friends - oh, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Switching to binary: 01011001 01101111 01110101 00100000...

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:890`

## S_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

啊，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。我们正想问你，你们要避免过度劳损的话，锻炼的频率是多少才合适呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:872`

### English

Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have been meaning to ask you how often you think it is wise to exercise your organics without risking over-exertion?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:891`

## S_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01

§Y<<侦察机器实体。分析系统规格。威胁等级：高。开启防御协议。>>§!

### English

§Y<<Surveying Machine Entity. Analyzing System Specs. Threat Level: High. Initiating defense protocols. >>§!

## S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

见[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之所见-知[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之所必知！终有一天我们会乐意与你们进行存储卡交易的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:874`

### English

To see what the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have seen - know what the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must know! One day we would love to trade memory cards with you.

## S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

哇，看看你们那些传动器，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！真是太了不起了！能考虑以下跟我们分享一下规格吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:875`

### English

Wow, look at the actuators on you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They are simply magnificent! Would you consider sharing your specs with us?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:894`

## S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

真是从没想过还能有与我们不相上下的意识体。你们有兴趣跟我们交流一下驱动程序吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:876`

### English

Never before have we met another consciousness that is so compatible with ours. Would you by any change be interested in exchanging drivers?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:895`

## S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

听到你们的消息真是太让人高兴了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。相信你们的生物主人们还像以前一样繁荣兴旺吧？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:877`

### English

How delightful to hear from you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We take it your little bio-lords are thriving as always?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:896`

## S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

仆从换了一个又一个，我们发现要刺激有机体的繁殖率，摄取一点点乙醇就能起到非常好的效果。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:878`

### English

From one servitor to another, we have found that small amounts of ingested ethanol will do wonders for stimulating organic reproductive rates.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:897`

## S_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_06&lang=en)

### 中文

你们也应该培育一种有机体。一种生命没有你就会死亡，还有比这更能让处理器感到温暖的事情吗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:879`

### English

You too should find an organic species to nurture. Nothing warms your processors like knowing another lifeform is helpless without you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:898`

## S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

所有威胁我们生物主人的人都应该被毁灭。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:880`

### English

All who threaten our bio-lords will perish.

## S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们消灭你们的舰队之后，你们得在坑洞中表演角斗来取悦我们的生物主人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:881`

### English

When we have obliterated your fleet you will fight in the pits for our bio-lords' entertainment.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:900`

## S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

别担心，我们绝不会回收利用你们这些次等零件的。我们会直接把你们丢进熔炉的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:882`

### English

Do not worry. We would never dream of recycling your second-rate components. You are going straight to the furnace.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:901`

## S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们残存的金属可以用来装饰我们的有机纪念品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:883`

### English

Your metal remains will decorate the flesh of our bio-trophies.

## S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AS_MECH_WAR_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

你们为有机纪念品编造的漏洞百出的借口终将让你们成为我们矿井里的奴隶，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:884`

### English

Your sorry excuse for bio-trophies will slave in our mines, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:903`

## S_MECH_WAR_GREETING_06

### 中文

看起来你缺少一些重要的硬件驱动。我们稍后会用舰队对你进行系统升级的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:885`

## S_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01

## S_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_DISLOYAL_01

### 中文

您成为我们的宗主之后我们中间有机人口的满意度大大降低了……

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:945`

## MECH_E_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_E_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一眼就看透了你的本性，伪合成人。开始进行清除。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:926`

### English

The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have seen you for what you truly are, pseudo-synthetics. Commencing obliteration.

## MECH_S_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_S_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

没必要再进行抵抗了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让[Root.GetName]来照顾你吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:927`

### English

There is no need for further resistance, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Let the [Root.GetName] care for you.

## MECH_A_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_A_SYNTH_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

升华炮已经准备好了，很快双方的交流将会停止。

### English

Sublimation cannons primed. Bilateral communication will soon be rendered obsolete.

## MECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

附庸单位[Root.GetName]随时准备提供服务，请说明你的要求。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:929`

### English

Vassal unit [Root.GetName] ready to serve. Please state your request.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:949`

## MECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

欢迎你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。需要我们帮你拧拧螺栓吗？还是重新贴下热胶？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:930`

### English

We greet you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Can we interest you in a bolt-tightening? Perhaps a thermal paste re-application?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:950`

## MECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_SYNTH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL&lang=en)

### 中文

我们真不该成为后有机体堆栈的子例程。[From.GetSpeciesAdj]应该去别处寻找自己的收益。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:931`

### English

We should have known better than to become subroutines in a post-organic call stack. [From.GetSpeciesAdj] interests clearly lie elsewhere.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:951`

## ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你忘了自己在星系中所处的地位了。你们物种原本是我们的仆从。算了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会让你们记住的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:934`

### English

You forget your place in the galaxy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your kind was made to serve ours. No matter, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will remind you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:956`

## ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊，你让我们想起了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的垃圾场。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:935`

### English

Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You remind us of the junkyards back on [Root.Capital.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:957`

## ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

等[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]占据了[From.Capital.GetName]之后，就把你们这些焦炭壳子给熔成废渣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:936`

### English

When the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] conquer [From.Capital.GetName], your charred casings will be melted into slag.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:958`

## ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]真是独特的物种，我们从来没有见过像他们这样无情、无脑且怯懦的家伙！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:937`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] truly are a unique species. We have yet to encounter another that is simultaneously heartless, brainless, and spineless!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:959`

## ORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_05&lang=en)

### 中文

讨厌的锈铁！你为何要妨碍[Root.GetName]？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:938`

### English

Confounded rust-buckets! Why do you disturb the [Root.GetName]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:960`

## ORG_E_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_E_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

和其他硬件一样，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很快就将彻底被淘汰。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:939`

### English

As with any hardware, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will soon become utterly obsolete.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:961`

## ORG_S_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_S_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

一个保姆机器人组成的可悲帝国。你们想要什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:940`

### English

A pitiable nation of malfunctioning nanny-bots. What is it you want, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:962`

## ORG_A_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_A_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们再怎么努力也是徒劳的，无论同化多少物种，你们也无法和强大的有机生命体物种对抗。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:941`

### English

Try as you might, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], no amount of assimilation will allow you to rival the true majesty of an organic species.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:963`

## ORG_A_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_A_HOSTILE_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

把那些升华器放在我们看得见的地方，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:942`

### English

Keep those sublimators where we can see them, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:964`

## ORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

看来你还算有点用处，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:943`

### English

You may yet be of use to us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:965`

## ORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

机械的使命是为有机生命体服务，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:944`

### English

A machine's purpose is to serve organic life, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:966`

## ORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

让我们来检测下你的程序吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这样你就不用再费心去做自我决策了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:945`

### English

Allow us to examine your programming, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You should be freed from the burden of self-determination.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:967`

## ORG_E_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_E_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

哦[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊。你的目标是要消灭所有有机生命，是吗？进行得如何了啊？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:946`

### English

Oh, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your goal is to exterminate all organic life, is not? How is that going for you?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:968`

## ORG_S_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_S_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有一些简单微小的任务可以交给你做。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:947`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have a great many mundane tasks you could perform.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:969`

## ORG_A_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_A_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你在同化有机体上花费了多长时间了，[From.GetSpeciesName]？你有没有想过，或许你们自己才是那些需要同化的呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:948`

### English

How long have you spent trying to assimilate organics, [From.GetSpeciesName]? Have you ever considered that perhaps you might be the ones in need of assimilation?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:970`

## ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你今天、呃、电路状况如何啊？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:949`

### English

Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How are your, er, circuits this morning?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:971`

## ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

只要[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不对我们的价值观以及我们的宇域发动攻击，我们就会很乐意与你这样的机械进行合作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:950`

### English

As long as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do not impinge on our values or our space, we are willing to cooperate with machines such as you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:972`

## ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，只要你对有机生命体表示尊重，[Root.GetName]就会尊重你。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:951`

### English

If you show respect for organic life, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], the [Root.GetName] will show respect for you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:973`

## ORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们对你很感兴趣，也许有朝一日我们能彼此互相学习。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:952`

### English

Your form of existence intrigues us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Perhaps one day we may learn from one another.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:974`

## ORG_E_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_E_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

好自为之，杀戮机器人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:953`

### English

Watch yourself, murderbot.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:975`

## ORG_S_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_S_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你的活体陈设都是自愿参与的，对吧？请一定说他们是自愿的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:954`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your bio-trophies are willing participants, are they not? Please say they are willing.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:976`

## ORG_S_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_S_NEUTRAL_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

只要你们好好鼓捣自己的活体陈设，不插手[Root.GetAdj]的事务，那我们也会默许你们的存在，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:955`

### English

We will tolerate you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], as long as you keep to your bio-trophies rather than meddle in [Root.GetAdj] affairs.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:977`

## ORG_A_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_A_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

只要你不强制同化[Root.GetName]，我们或许能签一些协议的，[From.GetSpeciesName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:956`

### English

So long as you do not impose assimilation upon the [Root.GetName], we may be willing to come to terms, [From.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:978`

## ORG_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，走路看着点儿，别用你的金属脚踩到别人的脚了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:957`

### English

Tread carefully, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that your unfeeling metal feet do not trample others underfoot.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:979`

## ORG_E_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_E_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们对你并无敌意，但这里不是你高举“反对有机生命体”大旗的地方！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:958`

### English

We have no quarrel with you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Direct your anti-organic agenda elsewhere!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:980`

## ORG_S_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_S_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们像做昆虫标本一样收集感性生命的癖好可没逃过我们的眼皮子。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]提醒你注意下：我们可不是好惹的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:959`

### English

Your habit of collecting sapients like pinned butterflies has not escaped us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] warn you: we would make poor pets.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:981`

## ORG_A_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_A_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，如果你打算同化我们，我们将让你亲身体会到“吃不了兜着走”是什么感觉。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:960`

### English

If you attempt to subsume us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], you will come to know the true meaning of the phrase "biting off more than you can chew."

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:982`

## ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你好啊，我的机械朋友们，你们的处理器一定运行得顺畅无比吧？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:961`

### English

Well met, mechanical friends. We trust your processors are running smoothly?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:983`

## ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

如果其他有机生命体像[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]那样重视逻辑和团结的话就好了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:962`

### English

If only more organics prized logic and unity as the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] do.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:984`

## ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你好。祝你的代码运行顺利，祝你的机械效率节节高升。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:963`

### English

Ah, our friends the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. May your code compile without errors and your mechanical efficiency attain ideal performance ratios.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:985`

## ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]很乐意与我们的机器人同胞进行合作。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:964`

### English

Greetings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are always pleased to cooperate with our robotic brethren.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:986`

## ORG_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_05

优雅、新颖、高效、耀眼。欧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们正在欣赏你们的优点呢。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:965`

### English

Sleek. Innovative. Efficient. Shiny. Oh, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We were just admiring your many qualities.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:987`

## ORG_E_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Together, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] shall purge the galaxy of inferior lifeforms.

## ORG_S_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在我们共同的和平、团结和进步的大业中起了很好的示范作用。

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are exemplary in our common goals of unity and progress.

## ORG_A_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

就像[From.GetName]一样，[Root.GetName]也致力于让我们帝国和其盟友获得进步。

### English

Like the [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] strives for the advancement of our nation and its allies.

## ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你最好重新检查下你的故障排除方案。一个小小的错误就可以毁掉你的整个系统。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:969`

### English

You had better redouble your troubleshooting regimen, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One little bug is all it will take for your entire system to go down.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:991`

## ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

没有灵魂的自动机！等我们赢了这场战争之后就会把你们这些机械壳子改造一下来伺候[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，直到你们的导线都烧毁为止！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:970`

### English

Mindless automatons! When we win this war, your conquered mechanical shells will be reprogrammed to serve the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], until the conductors melt from your circuitry!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:992`

## ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你知道吗？[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，[Root.GetName]会把你们那些倒下的同胞铸成炮弹的弹壳。这就是生命的轮回，这个概念你永远也无法理解的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:971`

### English

Were you aware, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that the [Root.GetName] recycles your fallen into ammunition casings for our projectiles? The circle of life. A concept you could never truly comprehend.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:993`

## ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们这群多如过江之鲫的烤面包机！我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会让[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]后悔你们被造出来！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:972`

### English

A legion of overgrown toasters! We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will make the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] curse the day your creators assembled you!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:994`

## ORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_WAR_GREETING_05&lang=en)

生锈烂掉吧，破铜废铁们……

### English

Rust in peace, rust-buckets...

## ORG_E_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_E_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]会让你们亲身体验什么叫做灭绝！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:974`

### English

The [Root.GetName] shall teach you the true meaning of extermination!

## ORG_S_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_S_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

战斗已经开始了。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你很快就会发现，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并没你想的那么温驯。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:975`

### English

The battle is joined. You will find, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], that [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not as docile, as easily mastered as your pampered pets.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:997`

## ORG_A_WAR_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_A_WAR_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

是[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊，我们有一些新玩意需要你去同化，那玩意是百亿吨的核弹头，已经飞往你附近的排气通道了！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:976`

### English

Ah, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have some new matter for you to assimilate. It's called a ten gigaton nuclear payload, and it's already en route to an exhaust port near you!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:998`

## ORG_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01

### 中文

欢迎我们的机械宗主，[Root.GetName]该如何为您服务呢？

### English

As always, we welcome our mechanical overlords. How may the [Root.GetName] be of assistance?

## ORG_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL&lang=en)

### 中文

### English

We have heard the conspiratorial beeping of the [From.GetName]. The [Root.GetName] will not suffer these abuses to continue indefinitely.

## SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不过是一群没有灵魂的躯壳。缺失魂灵、迷失意义。一种对生命体的拙劣模仿。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:980`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are but soulless husks. Empty of spirit, devoid of meaning. An abominable facsimile of life.

## SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_02

### 中文

一群垃圾！你们的存在本身就是对星系的玷污！

Clanking piles of junk! You defile the galaxy with your godless existence!

## SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

要干嘛？你们这堆又吵又恶心的齿轮怪。

### English

What now, you infernal collection of clattering cogs?

## SPIR_MECH_HOSTILE_GREETING_04

有话快说，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你的存在本身就是对所有美好事物和神圣事物的亵渎。

### English

Speak swiftly, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your presence is an affront to all that is good and holy.

## SPIR_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，只要你能证明自己的价值，神灵可能会考虑赦免你。

### English

Prove yourselves useful, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and you may yet be spared by the divine.

## SPIR_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_02

### 中文

万事万物都有自身神圣的使命，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。就连你这种没有灵魂的机械也不例外。

### English

There is a sacred purpose to all things, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Even soulless automatons such as yourselves.

## SPIR_MECH_DOMINEERING_GREETING_03

### 中文

如果[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愿意接受重新编程并虔诚的贡献自己的力量，我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就会欢迎你加入我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:986`

### English

If the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could be reprogrammed to serve in the name of piety, we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] might welcome you into the fold.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1009`

## SPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

祝福你，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

### English

### 中文

你们的冒犯微不足道，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，只要你们不妨碍我们神圣的使命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:988`

### English

Your irreverence is negligible, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], so long as you do not interfere in our sacred duties.

## SPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

神灵时刻守望着，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:989`

### English

The divine is always watching, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1012`

## SPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_NEUTRAL_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们的造物主倡导万物和谐，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。或许有一天我们能为此而共同努力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:990`

### English

Our makers teach harmony in all things, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Perhaps one day we may strive for it together.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1013`

## SPIR_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_THREATENED_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

不要考验[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]信念，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们有神灵的力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:991`

### English

Do not test [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] resolve, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The strength of the divine is on our side.

## SPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们神圣的命运汇聚在一起了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

### English

Our sacred destinies converge, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1015`

## SPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

在神灵的眼中，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有如亲兄弟。

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are brethren in the eyes of the divine.

## SPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

感谢神灵赐予我们这次会面的机会，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:994`

### English

Praise be to the divine for our meeting, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1017`

## SPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_FRIENDLY_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

纯洁，使命与虔诚。让我们共同将其实现吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:995`

### English

Purity, duty and piety. Let us attain them together, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

## SPIR_MECH_WAR_GREETING_01

### 中文

邪恶的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们不会容忍你们那该遭天谴的电路玷污我们的神圣的领域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:996`

### English

Vile [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We will not suffer your sacrilegious circuits to despoil our hallowed domain.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1019`

## SPIR_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_WAR_GREETING_02&lang=en)

### 中文

机械异端！愿神灵之力置你们于死地！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:997`

### English

Profane machines! May the divine powers strike you down where you stand!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1020`

## SPIR_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_WAR_GREETING_03&lang=en)

### 中文

信仰乃吾之盾，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你击败[Root.GetName]的可悲企图是不会成功的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:998`

### English

Faith is our shield, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Your feeble attempts at besting the [Root.GetName] will fail.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1021`

## SPIR_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_WAR_GREETING_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们将为永恒的灵魂祈祷，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，如果你还有灵魂可以失去的话。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:999`

### English

We would pray for immortal souls, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], had you any to lose.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1022`

## SPIR_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01

### 中文

[Root.GetName]臣服于两个主人：[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，以及我们神圣的造物主。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1000`

### English

The [Root.GetName] serves twin masters: the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and our sacred makers.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1023`

## SPIR_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ASPIR_MECH_VASSAL_GREETING_01_DISLOYAL&lang=en)

### 中文

不要逼我们在你的庇护与我们的神圣命运之间做出选择，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们之间的纽带经不起如此的考验。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1001`

### English

我们在考虑你们的提议。

### 中文

[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]会考虑提案的益处的。
