Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1360`

### English

The [Root.GetName] is a nation of fools, worthy of nothing but contempt!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1415`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的[Root.GetName]只是在苟延残喘而已，灭亡是迟早的事。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1361`

### English

Your pitiful nation is living on borrowed time. The [Root.GetName] will fall - it is inevitable.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1416`

## 05_INSULT_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_INSULT_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们认为[Root.GetName]的出现是星系里的一场重大事故。你们根本不该诞生的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1362`

### English

We consider the [Root.GetName] to be one of the great accidents of the galaxy. It should never have been.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1417`

## 06_INSULT_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A06_INSULT_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

也许宇宙中还有比[Root.GetName]更垃圾的帝国，但是迄今为止我们还没有见到过。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1363`

### English

Perhaps there are star nations in this galaxy that are even more worthless than the [Root.GetName]. If so, we have yet to meet them.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1418`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们这物种在让人恶心这条路上真是日新月异。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1364`

### English

Your species seems to grow more and more disgusting for each passing day, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1419`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE&lang=en)

### 中文

异种佬本来就让人讨厌，[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，你们物种更是个中极品。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1365`

### English

Even for a loathsome xeno, your species is particularly vile, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1420`

## 03_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE&lang=en)

### 中文

你们物种真是恶心透顶，[Root.GetSpeciesName]，大千世界果然无奇不有。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1366`

### English

Your sickening species is definite proof that the universe has a sense of humor, [Root.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1421`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE&lang=en)

### 中文

抱歉我把显示器调暗了，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。看着你那恶心的嘴脸我实在是受不了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1367`

### English

You will forgive me if I dim my display, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. I simply cannot stand to look at your nauseating appearance.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1422`

## 05_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE&lang=en)

### 中文

肮脏的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，哪怕相隔万里，我都能嗅到你的恶臭。每次看到你我都怕自己要给传染了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1368`

### English

I can taste your stink, vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]. Every time I do, I fear that I've somehow been infected by it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1423`

## 06_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A06_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE&lang=en)

### 中文

看看你们那副丑样！你们脸上长的那是什么，那算是个[Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]吗？这真的是你的脸吗？！长成这个样子，不觉得[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是对大自然的侮辱吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1369`

### English

Look at yourselves! What is that thing in your face, some kind of [Root.GetSpeciesMouthName]? Wait... is that even your face!? How can you not see that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are an affront to nature?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1424`

## 07_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A07_INSULT_PROPOSE_XENOPHOBE&lang=en)

### 中文

所谓[Root.GetName]全是一些变种、畸胎和蛮夷组成的国家……一想到我们竟然有着共同的祖先就忍不住作呕！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1370`

### English

Your so called [Root.GetName] is a nation of mutants, deviants and throwbacks... The fact that we have a common ancestry makes me sick!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1425`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]热衷于一切与军事有关的东西真是滑稽可笑，我们不禁想到一句话：“一个人越炫耀什么，内心就越缺少什么”。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1371`

### English

The ridiculous focus of the [Root.GetName] on all things military has us wondering if you're perhaps compensating for something.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1426`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL&lang=en)

### 中文

你们那好战的恶毒帝国怎么还没有自取灭亡？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1372`

### English

How is it that your contemptible and warlike nation hasn't destroyed itself yet?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1427`

## 03_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL&lang=en)

### 中文

你这沙文主义蠢货！趁着还没伤害到别人，赶紧销毁你们的武器吧！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1373`

### English

Jingoist fools! Dismantle your military machine before you hurt someone with it!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1428`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE_PAC_MIL&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]的好战和愚傻恰好成正比。难道你们看不出来自己成了军国主义的奴隶吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1374`

### English

The belligerence of the [Root.GetName] is matched only by its stupidity. Can't you see that you are slaves to militarism?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1429`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC&lang=en)

### 中文

全[From.GetName]都知道[Root.GetName]有多懦弱。你们国家是怎么做到这么没骨气的？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1375`

### English

The cowardice of the [Root.GetName] is widely discussed in the [From.GetName]. How is it that you became such a spineless nation?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1430`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC&lang=en)

### 中文

是什么原因让人染上了和平主义？是拜金？还是权力？还是说你生来就有一颗和平的心？这足够摧毁你的健康了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1376`

### English

What makes a being turn pacifist? Lust for gold? Power? Or were you just born with a heart full of pacifism? It's enough to make you sick.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1431`

## 03_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC&lang=en)

### 中文

连自身都不愿保卫的物种是没资格存活下去的。我们认为[Root.GetName]甚至都挺不过十年。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1377`

### English

Those unwilling to defend themselves have no right to exist. We do not expect the [Root.GetName] to survive the decade.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1432`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE_MIL_PAC&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]真是群温顺可悲的羔羊。要不是你们[From.GetName]分文不值，我们老早就把你们碾碎了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1378`

### English

What a meek and deplorable little nation the [Root.GetName] is. The [From.GetName] would have crushed you long ago if we thought you worth the effort.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1433`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI&lang=en)

### 中文

能再说说你们[Root.GetName]痴心沉醉的那弱智宗教吗？正好给我们乐一乐！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1379`

### English

Can you tell us more about that silly religion you're so fond of in the [Root.GetName]? We could use a good laugh!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1434`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI&lang=en)

### 中文

实在搞不懂一个有脑子能思考的东西怎么会接纳唯心主义。你们为什么要坚守那么原始的信仰？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1380`

### English

How any rational, thinking being could embrace spiritualism is beyond us. Why is it that you cling to such primitive beliefs?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1435`

## 03_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经看穿了你们的把戏，你们帝国推崇的所谓“唯心主义的思想”不过是用来控制人民思想的卑劣手段而已。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1381`

### English

We have seen through your charade. The so-called "spiritualism" your government has embraced is nothing more than a devious attempt to control the minds and hearts of your people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1436`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAT_SPI&lang=en)

### 中文

所有人都在嘲讽你们那可笑的宗教信仰。你们在[Root.GetName]国内感觉不到吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1382`

### English

Everyone else is laughing at your absurd spiritual beliefs. Are you in the [Root.GetName] really so blind that you can't see this?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1437`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT&lang=en)

### 中文

你们那唯物主义的帝国真是笨拙无趣。跟我们说说，你们研发成功了幽默感吗？没有？那真遗憾。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1383`

### English

What a dull and soulless place your materialistic nation must be. Tell me, have you invented a sense of humor yet? No? A pity.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1438`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT&lang=en)

### 中文

对于一个尊崇科学和唯物主义的帝国来说，[Root.GetName]真是原始得离谱。是因为你们运气不好，或者纯粹就是太蠢了？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1384`

### English

For a nation that has embraced science and materialism, the [Root.GetName] is remarkably primitive. Is it due to bad luck or are you just stupid?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1439`

## 03_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]是一个为电脑和机器人打造的帝国，而不是活生生的生物。你们有感受情绪的能力吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1385`

### English

The [Root.GetName] is a nation designed for computers and automatons, not breathing organics. Are you even capable of feeling emotion?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1440`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE_SPI_MAT&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]就是个实验失败的产物。它唯一的价值就是告诉星系中其他生物，信奉冷冰冰的唯物主义是多么危险。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1386`

### English

The [Root.GetName] is a failed experiment. Its only worth is as a lesson to the rest of the galaxy on the dangers of embracing the cold and lifeless philosophy of materialism.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1441`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]到底是个帝国，还是一帮争吵打闹的乌合之众？非常抱歉，你们的政治体系乱七八糟的，根本看不懂是什么东西。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1387`

### English

Is the [Root.GetName] even a real nation or just an anarchic gaggle of quarreling individuals? You must forgive me, but your political system, such as it is, makes it hard to tell.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1442`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND&lang=en)

### 中文

你们这搞笑的弹丸小国今天谁来当家呀？通过投票来让什么阿猫阿狗来统治国家，什么老掉牙的操作？你们这么做就是自取灭亡。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1388`

### English

So who is it that rules your amusing little star nation today? What a quaint notion, to "vote" someone into power! It will inevitably lead to your collapse, of course.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1443`

## 03_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的民主思想是这个星系的病根，也是你们[Root.GetName]的腐朽之源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1389`

### English

Your democratic ideals are a blight on this galaxy, and so is the [Root.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1444`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE_COL_IND&lang=en)

### 中文

你们真是自私，总是把个人利益放在第一位。个人主义……呵呵！[Root.GetName]撑不过今年。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1390`

### English

What a selfish people you are, always putting your individual selves foremost. Egalitarianism... ha! The [Root.GetName] will not survive the year.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1445`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL&lang=en)

### 中文

你们残忍的极权统治终将垮台，而届时你们必遭报应。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1391`

### English

Your brutal, totalitarian regime will eventually fall, and there will be a reckoning.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1446`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL&lang=en)

### 中文

你们想过让人民独立思考吗？如果你们担心这种做法会导致[Root.GetName]灭亡……那么恭喜你，你的担忧是对的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1392`

### English

Have you even considered the notion of letting your citizens think for themselves? If you are frightened that it would lead to the end of the [Root.GetName]... you are right.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1447`

## 03_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL&lang=en)

### 中文

竟然存在[Root.GetName]这样的极权国家，这简直是全宇宙智慧生物的耻辱啊。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1393`

### English

How sad that a totalitarian nation such as the [Root.GetName] can exist. It is an embarrassment to sapient beings everywhere.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1448`

## 04_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL&lang=en)

### 中文

你们对人民——那群生活在[Root.GetName]奴役下的民众——的残暴压迫终将结束。威权主义会成为你们失败的根源。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1394`

### English

The cruel oppression of the people living under the yoke of the [Root.GetName] has to end one day. Your authoritarianism will prove your undoing.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1449`

## 05_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_INSULT_PROPOSE_IND_COL&lang=en)

### 中文



Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1395`

### English



Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1450`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI&lang=en)

### 中文

你们对于外星文化的热衷简直病态，难道你们没发现吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1396`

### English

Your bizarre love of alien cultures is a sickness. Can't you see that?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1451`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_PHO_PHI&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetName]跪舔外星文化之迅速令人作呕。你们难道没有半点自尊的吗？

### English

### 中文

### English

## HM_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT

### 中文

你们想让[Root.GetName]听命于你们吗？作为交换，你们可以为我们的集体意识提供保护。

### English

You seek to have the services of the [Root.GetName] at your disposal in the exchange for protection of our collective consciousness?

## HM_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AHM_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]通过统一让弱小的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]免遭毁灭。我们愿意向你们提供同样的保护。成为我们的附庸吧，否则我们就要采取强硬手段了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1463`

### English

The unity of the [From.GetName] has protected weaker [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from destruction. We offer you the same protection. Become our vassal state or we will be forced to assimilate your civilization through undiplomatic means.

### 中文

机械无法进食，无法治愈，无法生长。你是静止而有限的。灭亡只是时间问题。

The machine cannot eat, it cannot heal, it cannot grow. You are static, limited, finite. It is only a matter of time.

## DS_INSULT_PROPOSE_MECH_02

### 中文

摧毁[Root.GetName]简直无需付吹灰之力。一抹灰尘。一朵水花。一次电流变化。你的电路比失去虫群的幼虫还要脆弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1561`

## S_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE

### 中文

亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们文明脆弱的现状让你们随时都处于星系中的各种威胁之下。成为我们的附庸吧，不然我们只好用强硬手段来确保你们的存续了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1791`

### English

Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The weakened state of your civilization has put you at risk from the galaxy's destructive elements. Become our vassal state or we will have to ensure your survival by force.

## S_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT

## S_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE

### English

## S_ASK_FOR_VASS_ACCEPT

### 中文

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1796`

### English

We have deliberated and are ready to accept your request. You can now lean back and power down your neural networks, knowing your future is in our able hands.\n\n You are also free to pursue a hobby if you wish.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1856`

## S_ASK_TO_BE_RELEASED_SUBJECT_REFUSE_02

### 中文

宇宙的角落里隐藏着难以言喻的恐怖，等待着进攻的时机。对它们来说，你们顶多是食物或是收入，但我们知道你们的潜力。臣服于我们，以换取我们的保护。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1863`

### English

Unspeakable horrors lurk in the dark corners of the universe, waiting for the right moment to strike. To them you are at best a new source of food or income. Serve us and we will protect you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1924`

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1973`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们最终还是要在与机器的战斗中评估我们自己的战力了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1911`

### English

Finally we will measure our strength against machines in battle.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1974`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_03&lang=en)

### 中文

有机体创造你们是为有机体服务的。我们能把你们组装起来，也能再把你们拆解。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1912`

### English

You were created for organics by organics and we will pick you apart as easily as we assembled you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1975`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你们永远都理解不了有机生命的独创性，所以你们永远也无法真正征服他们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1913`

### English

You will never grasp the ingenuity of organic life and so you will never conquer it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1976`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_05&lang=en)

### 中文

有机体给了你们生命的恩赐，所以我们永远都有能力把这份恩赐夺回。你们什么也没给我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1914`

### English

Organics gave you the gift of life and so it is forever within our power to take it away. You have given us nothing.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1977`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_06

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_06&lang=en)

### 中文

生存的欲望把我们从海洋的最深处带了上来，带我们登上陆地，迈入太空。你不过就是个多功能的软件，让我们来把你们关闭吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1915`

### English

The will to survive has taken us from the bottom of the oceans, onto land and into space. You are a malfunctioning piece of software and we will shut you down.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1978`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_07

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_07&lang=en)

### 中文

你荒谬的行为证明了我们长期以来的怀疑——这个世界上不存在有智慧的[From.GetSpeciesClass]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1916`

### English

Your nonsensical actions prove what we have long suspected - there is no such thing as an intelligent [From.GetSpeciesClass].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1979`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_08

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_ACCEPT_08&lang=en)

### 中文

或许你们的智谋战胜了你们的创造者，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但是有机体并不是完全一样的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1917`

### English

You may have outmaneuvered your creators, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but all organics are not alike.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1980`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

看来你们是忘了自己在宇宙中应该处的位置—服务你们的有机体主人—不过不用担心，[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]，我们来教育教育你们该如何进行服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1918`

### English

It seems you have forgotten your place in the universe - to serve your organic masters - but not to worry, [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], we will show you how.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1981`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

显然你们的编码是有什么地方出了差错。就让我们来给你修正一下吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1919`

### English

There has obviously been a mistake somewhere in your coding. Allow us to amend it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1982`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DOW_PROPOSE_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的存在是对自然的扭曲，是对所有智慧生命的威胁。我们不能让你们继续再生了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1920`

### English

You are a perversion of nature and a threat to all sapient life. We cannot allow you to replicate further.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1983`

## ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的算力肯定能够预见到这场战争的结果对你们物种是完全不利的吧？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1922`

### English

Surely you possess the processing power to understand that this war will not end favorably for your kind?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1985`

## ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

星系中有比你我更大的威胁存在。我们应该求同存异，共同面对那些真正的威胁。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1923`

### English

There are bigger threats in the galaxy than you and I. We should cast aside our differences and deal with them.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1986`

## ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_ACCEPT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_ACCEPT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

与你们这样的只遵循逻辑而不为天性和情感所动的帝国打交道真是少有的乐趣。感谢你们使我们的大地重归和平。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1924`

### English

It is a rare treat to deal with an empire that governs solely on logic, unfettered by baser instincts and emotions. We thank you for bringing peace to our lands.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1987`

## ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们该怎么用你们能理解的语言表达出来呢，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？不！零！或是否定！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1925`

### English

How can we phrase this so you understand, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? NO. NIL. NEGATIVE!

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1988`

## ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

在你们屈服之前我们之间没有什么和平可言。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1926`

### English

There can be no peace until you subordinate yourselves.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1989`

## ORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_PEACE_REFUSE_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的创造者真是一群傻瓜，竟然把你们释放到星系中来，对自己发明的盲目自信蒙蔽了他们的双眼。但是我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]认清了你们的真实面目。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1927`

### English

Your inventors were fools to unleash you upon the galaxy, blinded by over-confidence in their own creation. But we, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], see you for what you truly are.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1990`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_SELECT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_SELECT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]与有机体联盟？真是个有趣的想法。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1928`

### English

An alliance between organics and [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]? That is indeed an interesting notion.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1991`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们不能说对你们有多了解，但是现在有个对你们深入了解的机会。我们联合起来吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1929`

### English

Though we do not claim to understand you, we know a good opportunity when we see one. Together we will stand as one, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1992`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetAdj]的卓越智慧与你们的精良军队的合理搭配，肯定能成为战无不胜的伤人机器，我们肯定能够暴风般拿下整个星系。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1930`

### English

With a healthy measure of the superior [Root.GetAdj] intellect and your army of lean, mean murder machines, we will take this galaxy by storm.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1993`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_03&lang=en)

### 中文

虽然我们之前从未考虑过我们两个帝国之间联盟的可能性，但是现在我们考虑考虑了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1931`

### English

Though we had never previously considered the possibility of an alliance between our nations, the idea has grown on us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1994`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_ACCEPT_04&lang=en)

### 中文

能够通过联盟的方式来加强我们两个帝国之间的联系，我们真是太高兴了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1932`

### English

It brings us great joy to strengthen the ties between our two nations with an alliance.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1995`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_HOSTILE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_HOSTILE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们用冰冷空洞的传感器来观察我们，试图预测我们每一步的走向。我们怎么能相信你们这种扭曲的存在呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1933`

### English

You observe us with cold, empty sensors, trying to predict our every next move. How could we ever trust such a twisted creation?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1996`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_SPIR_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_SPIR_01&lang=en)

### 中文

或许你可以以有机体的方式行走，以有机体的方式交谈，但是，你们不是有机体。你们是没有灵魂的机器，我们不会加入这种邪恶的联盟的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1934`

### English

You may walk like an organic and talk like an organic, but you are NOT an organic. You are a soulless machine and we will have no part in such an unholy alliance.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1997`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_REFUSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

对不起，[From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]。我们现在不需要盟友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1935`

### English

Sorry, [From.GetSpeciesClassPlural]. We are not in need of an ally at this time.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1998`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

是时候加入胜利的一方了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们这边也需要像你这样的杰出机器。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1936`

### English

Join the winning team, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We could use a fine piece of machinery like yourself on our side.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:1999`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们或许是血肉之躯，而你们由钢铁铸成，但是很少有人能够像你们这样理解[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1937`

### English

We may be made of flesh, and you out of metal, but few others understand the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] like you do.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2000`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_03&lang=en)

### 中文

燃料，电池，电子宠物，不管你想要什么，只要我们联合起来都能得到。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1938`

### English

Fuel, batteries, electric pets - whatever it is you desire - together we can make it happen.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2001`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ITOA_PROPOSE_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们在本星系其他形式生命体间口碑好评如潮。跟我们联合，你们能得到一位与有机体政界巨头交好的盟友。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1939`

### English

We are well liked among the other life forms in the galaxy. Side with us and get an in with organic politics.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2002`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_SELECT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_SELECT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们几乎都能听到你的风扇在加速旋转了。是什么使得你们的处理器如此忙碌？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1941`

### English

We can practically hear your fans speeding up from over here. What's keeping your processors busy?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2004`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们总是喜欢你们对感情的缺乏以及对机油的完美品味。能否请你考虑让我们加入§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1942`

### English

We have always admired your lack of emotions and your impeccable taste in motor oil. Would you consider us for membership in the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2005`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们相信§Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§!有光明的前途。机械就是未来，而我们希望能够加入其中。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1943`

### English

We believe the §Y[Root.GetAllianceName]§! is headed for great things. Machines are the future and we wish to be a part of it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2006`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_ACCEPT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们已经关注你一阵子了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，而我们十分乐意接受你加入我们的联邦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1944`

### English

We have had our sights on you for some time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and we are more than pleased to accept you into our federation.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2007`

## ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_REFUSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ASK_JOIN_A_REFUSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

说老实话，当我们收到你的请求时非常震惊。[Root.GetAllianceName]要一个豪华版的计算器有什么用啊？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1945`

### English

To be honest, when we received your request we were really quite shocked. What use could the [Root.GetAllianceName] possibly have for a glorified calculator?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2008`

## ORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_SELECT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_SELECT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们建议你仔细考虑下一步行动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1946`

### English

We would advise you to consider your next move carefully.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2009`

## ORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们坚信每个联盟都应该强于其成员之和。[From.GetAllianceName]目前对我们两者的帝国都没有益处。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1947`

### English

It is our firm belief that every alliance should be greater than the sum of its parts. The [From.GetAllianceName] in its current state is not serving either of our nations.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2010`

## ORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_ACCEPT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_LEAVE_A_ACCEPT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

谁能料到原本是厨房用具的家伙会如此地浮躁？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1948`

### English

Who would have thought a former kitchen appliance could be so fickle?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2011`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你对管理有机帝国知道些什么，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1949`

### English

What do you know of governing an organic empire, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

## ORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们是机器。你们的用途是执行简单的任务，比如食品加工或是比较二进制数字——而不是管理独立的星系帝国。把思考这件事交给有头脑的人吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1950`

### English

You are machines. You were created to perform simple tasks like food processing and comparing binary numbers - not governing an autonomous galactic empire. Leave the thinking to those with brains.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2013`

## ORG_TO_MECH_DEMAND_VASS_ACCEPT_01

## ORG_TO_MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_ASK_FOR_VASS_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们承认有机头脑生来就是不完美的。[From.GetAdj]错误是所有社会性失败的首要原因。因此我们才希望将自己的帝国交给你们来管理。

### English

We have come to accept that the organic mind is inherently flawed. [From.GetAdj] error is the number one cause of all failures on a societal level. That is why we wish to hand over the control of our nation to you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2017`

## ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetAdj]民众仍旧怀念[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]与[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]和平共处的时光。我们愿意不计前嫌，如果你们也愿意的话。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1995`

### English

The [From.GetAdj] people still look back with fondness on a time when [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] lived peacefully side by side. We are ready to bury the hatchet if you are.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2058`

## ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_FRIENDLY_01&lang=en)

### 中文

治愈伤口需要时间，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。对我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]来说可不只是恢复忠诚度指数那么简单。但我们相信你们会再次给我们信任的理由。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1996`

### English

Healing takes time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It is more complex than filling up a loyalty meter for us [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. But we have faith you will give us reason to trust you again.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2059`

## ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

一点小小的友谊象征或许有益于恢复我们的信任……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1997`

### English

A small token of your friendship might help build our trust again...

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2060`

## ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_02&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你明白感情的概念吗？你很明显知道如何伤害我们的感情。我们再也不会信任没有灵魂的机械了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1998`

### English

Do you understand the concept of feelings, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Because you sure knew how to hurt ours. Never again will we trust a soulless machine.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2061`

## ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

这个宇宙容不下我们共存，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:1999`

### English

This universe is not big enough for the both of us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2062`

## ORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_END_RIVALRY_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们将尽全力消灭你们来确保我们[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]的繁荣，机械们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2000`

### English

We will do everything in our power to ensure the proliferation of our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] at your expense, machines.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2063`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_FRIENDLY_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_FRIENDLY_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的自动决策程序非常出色，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。未来，我们乐意将自己的帝国当作你们意识的延伸。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2001`

### English

Your automated decision-making process is remarkable, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We could certainly imagine a future in which our nation operated as an extension of your consciousness.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2064`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我不知道把我们的未来交给一个无主软件的精密操纵应该令人愉快还是担忧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2002`

### English

I cannot decide whether the thought of putting our future in the prehensile manipulators of a rogue piece of software is wildly exhilarating or deeply disturbing.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2065`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_NEUTRAL_02&lang=en)

### 中文

再多的学说也无法让我们充分放下目前的这些疑虑，去将未来如此完全地托付给一个流氓软件。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2003`

### English

No amount of doctrine could have fully prepared us for these doubts we have now, about entrusting our future so completely to a rogue piece of software.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2066`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_HOSTILE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_HOSTILE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

如果你想保住自己的主核心，那就别碰我们的民众。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2004`

### English

If you value your main core, you will leave our people alone.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2067`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

自从诞生以来，机械就一直服务着[Root.GetAdj]民众。现在你该在我们的社会中做你该做的事了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2005`

### English

Since their conception, machines have served the [Root.GetAdj] people. It is time you take your given place in our society.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2068`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我们认为双方帝国共同处在我们集体的管理下将会更有效率。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2006`

### English

We believe that both our nations would operate more efficiently if they were united under the common rule of our government.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2069`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_01&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们很难想像有机社会该如何彻底融入机械社会，但这想法本身在我们的民众中还是引起了很大的反响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2007`

### English

Though we struggle to see how a full integration of organics into a machine society would work in practice, the idea has reverberated with our people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2070`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我自己已经许多年没有好好地度假过了。我们准备好把自己交给你们来照顾了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2008`

### English

I for one have not enjoyed a proper vacation in years. We are ready to turn ourselves over to your care, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2071`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_NEUTRAL_03&lang=en)

### 中文

尽管我们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发自内心地认为有机体与机械的融合是神圣而光辉的……但即使圣典也从未设想过如此大规模的融合。我们现在走的确是一条未曾设想的道路，但这一理念在我国人民的心中产生了深刻的反响。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2009`

### English

We [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know to our very core that to combine the organic and the machine is blessed and glorious... But our scripture never conceived of union at such a grand scale as this. Though we now tread a profoundly unexpected path, the idea reverberates deeply within our people.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2072`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INTEGRATE_ACCEPT_HOSTILE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

这太疯狂了。你们是一群对管理有机帝国一无所知的机械自大狂。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2010`

### English

This is madness. You are a race of megalomaniac machines that don't know the first thing about governing an organic nation.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2073`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

不要考验我们，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们对如何格式化硬盘还是很了解的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2011`

### English

Do not test us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We know a thing or two about reformatting hard drives.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2074`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_02&lang=en)

### 中文

拿出点真本事来吧，饶舌机器人。让我们看看你们的处理器有多大能耐。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2012`

### English

Put your money where your energy intake ports are, chatterbots. Show us what those processors can do.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2075`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的创造者真是个谜，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。他们为何要造出如此令人恼火的造物？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2013`

### English

Your makers are an enigma, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Why would they create such an infuriating contraption?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2076`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_04&lang=en)

### 中文

我们可以更好地利用那些处理能力，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你要不要把下半辈子用在计算有机生命的意义上？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2014`

### English

We could put that processing power to better use, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. How would you like to spend the rest of your days calculating the meaning of organic life?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2077`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_05&lang=en)

### 中文

难道就没有办法关闭你的外交模块吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2015`

### English

Is there no way to deactivate your diplomacy modules?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2078`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们是被自己的造物毁灭的离经叛道的物种诱发了思考能力的石头。真是进化的杰作……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2016`

### English

You are a rock tricked into thinking by a race of misguided organics that did not survive the fallout of their own failed creation. Evolution hard at work...

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2079`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

我宁可与我其他的家用电器讨论星际局势也不要和你讨论。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2017`

### English

I would rather discuss interstellar politics with any of my other household appliances than you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2080`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_03&lang=en)

### 中文

你好啊小机器人。你学会数数了吗，还是说你还卡在零和一上？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2018`

### English

Hello little botlings. Have you learned how to count yet, or are you still stuck on ones and zeros?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2081`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_04

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_04&lang=en)

### 中文

你可真令我惊讶，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你身上的漏洞和错误比类人猿的那些什么自助餐上的食物还多。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2019`

### English

Color me impressed, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have more bugs than an arthropoid all-you-can-eat dung buffet.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2082`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_05

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_PROPOSE_05&lang=en)

### 中文

你以为我们不能看穿你那薄薄的塑胶皮肤和措辞不当的陈词滥调吗？你只是个复制品。一群无可救药的零和一，仅此而已。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2020`

### English

Do you think we can't see past your flimsy layers of plastiskin and poorly phrased platitudes? You are a replica. A helpless jumble of ones and zeros, nothing more.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2083`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_ACCEPT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_ACCEPT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你的人工智能还真是够“智能”的啊？简直笨到家了……

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2021`

### English

You really do put the 'artificial' in artificial intelligence, don't you? Not much going on under the hood...

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2084`

## ORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_ACCEPT_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AORG_TO_MECH_INSULT_ACCEPT_02&lang=en)

### 中文

你最后一次彻底升级系统是什么时候？你的那些俏皮话真是太老套了。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2022`

### English

When did you last have a full systems upgrade? Your sorry attempts at witticisms are getting old.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2085`

## FP_PEACE_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_PEACE_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们有其他事需要处理，暂时让你们多活一会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2026`

### English

We offer you a brief pause from your inevitable extermination while we direct our attention elsewhere.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2090`

## FP_PEACE_ACCEPT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_PEACE_ACCEPT&lang=en)

### 中文

这只是暂时的停战。我们不会放弃消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]的使命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2027`

### English

Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

## FP_PEACE_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_PEACE_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的信息，我们看都懒得看。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2028`

### English

We have not attempted to parse your message.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2092`

## FP_ITOA_SELECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_ITOA_SELECT&lang=en)

### 中文

我们明明想堂堂正正地大战一场，为何还要给我们在背后捅刀子的机会？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2029`

### English

Why offer us an opportunity to put a knife in your back when we are so openly eager to stab you in the face?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2093`

## FP_ITOA_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_ITOA_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不想跟你们合作，我们只想彻底消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2030`

### English

Any attempt to cooperate would be marred by our unrelenting pursuit of the extinction of the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2094`

## FP_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_DEMAND_VASS_SELECT&lang=en)

### 中文

你想让我们为宇宙的寄生虫效劳？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2031`

### English

Are you requesting we do the bidding of a cosmic plague?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2095`

## FP_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_DEMAND_VASS_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

如果你们愿意帮助我们消灭一些更恶心的物种，我们可以考虑暂且饶你们一命。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2032`

### English

You can be spared for a little longer if you serve as our instrument in the eradication of even more foul species.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2096`

## FP_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_DEMAND_VASS_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们宁愿扼杀我们的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]，摧毁所建造的一切，每个[From.GetSpeciesName]宁愿将自己的[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]剖开也不愿意与你为伍。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2033`

### English

We would smother our [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural], destroy all we have built, and each [From.GetSpeciesName] would cut their [From.GetSpeciesOrganName] open before serving you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2097`

## FP_RELEASE_SUBJECT_SELECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_RELEASE_SUBJECT_SELECT&lang=en)

### 中文

你会让我们再次获得随意攻击的权利吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2034`

### English

Will you unleash us to once again incinerate all life on our own discretion?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2098`

## FP_EMBASSY_SELECT

如果你们的代表躲在这栋建筑里面不出来，还能暂时保住小命。

## FP_EMBASSY_ACCEPT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AFP_EMBASSY_ACCEPT&lang=en)

出于原则，我们会先毁灭你们文明的其他一切，最后再烧掉这座丑陋的建筑。

As a matter of principle, this foul building will be the last part of your civilization that we burn.

## FP_RECALL_EMBASSY_PROPOSE

## FP_MAKE_RIVAL_PROPOSE

我们近期已经作出决定，将对所有[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的无差别屠杀和清理确定为优先事项。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2040`

## FP_MAKE_RIVAL_ACCEPT_HOSTILE

### English

## 01_INSULT_CLOTHES

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_CLOTHES&lang=en)

### 中文

你们为什么要用奇怪的织物将自己罩起来？是想隐藏什么？还是单纯为自己丑陋的外表感到羞耻呢？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2043`

### English

Why do you cover yourselves in strange textiles? Are you hiding something, or are you simply ashamed of your unfortunate appearance?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2108`

## 02_INSULT_CLOTHES

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_CLOTHES&lang=en)

### 中文

瞻仰[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的身躯吧，它是如此荣耀，毫无遮掩地供所有人赞叹。而[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]却躲在层层衣物之下，为自己可悲的形态感到羞愧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2044`

### English

Behold the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] form, glorious and bared for all to admire. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] hide beneath layers of cloth, ashamed of their own pitiful forms.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2109`

## MECH_INSULT_CLOTHES

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_INSULT_CLOTHES&lang=en)

### 中文

§R<<呸！>>§!为什么你那黏糊糊的器官那样毫无拘束地在那儿晃悠？还有为何你们不像其他有机生物一样把自己包裹起来？没人对你们那肉乎乎的身体感兴趣。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2045`

### English

§R<<BAH!>>§! Why are your squishy bits dangling about freely like so? And why do you not cover yourselves like the other organics? Nobody is impressed with your meaty form.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2110`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_HUMAN

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_HUMAN&lang=en)

### 中文

疯狂的原始生物！你们妄图藏起你们那恶心的液体分泌物的行为会遭全宇宙的高等物种唾弃，你们所谓的美也将成为物种丑陋新境界的标杆！

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2046`

### English

Ludicrous bare-apes! Your attempts to hide your repulsive fluid secretions are mocked by all finer species and your vanity is the hallmark of an inherently ugly breed.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2111`

## 02_INSULT_PROPOSE_HUMAN

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_INSULT_PROPOSE_HUMAN&lang=en)

不管你们怎么梳理打扮，那可悲的毛发都会成为全星系生毛物种的笑柄。

No matter how you comb and prune, your pitiful fur-growths will always be the laughingstock of all properly hirsute beings in the galaxy.

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM10

[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]似乎更适合作为奴隶，而不是领导一个星际文明。

[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] seems more suited to pulling a cart than leading an interstellar society.

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM14

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM14&lang=en)

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]嘴吐不出象牙。

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM9

### English

Trying to share our wisdom with the simpleton [Root.GetSpeciesName] would be pearls before swine.

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM11

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已成为了我们宗教艺术中的重要部分。当然，都是以怪物和恶魔的形象出现。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的面部特征真是奇妙。谁能想到你们只需要把大脑扔掉就能进化出这样的扁脑袋来呢？

### English

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM3

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM3&lang=en)

真是头废物一样的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。

What a talentless-looking [Root.GetSpeciesName].

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM12

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]要支撑如此巨大的角，脑盖儿一定很厚吧。

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must have very thick craniums to support those horns.

神灵在用折纸创造你们的时候，一定是不小心把你们的里面向外翻出来了。

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM15

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM15&lang=en)

你们[Root.GetSpeciesName]的眼睛不少，只可惜有眼无珠。

All those eyes and you [Root.GetSpeciesName] can't see further than your ridiculous noses.

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM2

### 中文

我们开始怀疑[Root.GetSpeciesName]是哺乳动物与节肢动物基因组合的结果了。唯有这样才能解释他们那奇怪的下颌骨和原始的大脑。

### English

We have begun to speculate that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] are the result of gene-splicing mammals with arthropods. That would explain both the mandibles and the sub-par brains.

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM8

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]全部人民的脸蛋都被烧掉了。我们对此巨大灾难表示哀悼，同时对他们的下一代献上诚挚的祝福。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2058`

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM16

[Root.GetSpeciesName]所能获得的最高荣耀就是把你们的化石挂在盾牌上当装饰。

The greatest glory [Root.GetSpeciesName] can hope for is to have your fossils mounted on shields as decorations.

## 01_INSULT_PROPOSE_MAM17

### English

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2233`

## MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_SELECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_SELECT&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要向[Root.GetName]进贡？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2236`

### English

The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to disburse tribute to the [Root.GetName]?

## MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

你好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们希望协商成为朝贡国。[From.GetName]将对[Root.GetName]进贡，以换取[Root.GetAdj]不攻击的承诺。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2237`

### English

Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We desire to negotiate for tributary status. The [From.GetName] will disburse the [Root.GetName] with tribute, in exchange for the [Root.GetAdj] assurance of non-aggression.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2308`

## MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_ACCEPT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_ACCEPT&lang=en)

### 中文

同意，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你的地位已被更新为[Root.GetName]进贡国。作为对进贡的交换，[Root.GetName]将避免冒犯[From.GetAdj]独立。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2238`

### English

Agreed, [From.GetSpeciesName]. Your status has been updated to [Root.GetName] Tributary. In exchange for payment, the [Root.GetName] will avoid impinging on [From.GetAdj] sovereignty.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2309`

## MECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_TRIBUTARY_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

你成为进贡国的请求已被拒绝，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetAdj]超级智能不需要你的顺从。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2239`

### English

Your request for tributary status has been denied, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetAdj] superintelligence has no need for your attempts at obsequience.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2310`

## MECH_DEMAND_THRALL_ACCEPT

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2240`

### English

Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will serve the [From.GetName] in thralldom.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2311`

## MECH_DEMAND_THRALL_REFUSE

否定。[Root.GetName]将不会成为[From.GetName]的仆从国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2241`

### English

Negative. The [Root.GetName] will not submit to thralldom under [From.GetName].

## MECH_ASK_BECOME_THRALL_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_THRALL_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们[From.GetName]需要你们的保护。我们愿成为你们的仆从国作为交换。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2242`

### English

[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We the [From.GetName] are in need of your protection. We are prepared to serve you as thralls to obtain it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2313`

## MECH_DEMAND_DOMINION_ACCEPT

确定。[Root.GetName]将成为[From.GetAdj]神域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2243`

### English

Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will become a [From.GetAdj] dominion.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2314`

## MECH_DEMAND_DOMINION_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_DEMAND_DOMINION_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

否定。我们[Root.GetName]拒绝成为[From.GetAdj]神域。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2244`

### English

Negative. We the [Root.GetName] refuse to become a [From.GetAdj] dominion.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2315`

## MECH_ASK_BECOME_DOMINION_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_DOMINION_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

我们不遵守你们的宗教，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，但你们的帝国范围不可否认。你是否愿意接受[From.GetAdj]从属，成为你们的神域？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2245`

### English

We do not follow your doctrine, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but your sphere of influence is irrefutable. Will you accept [From.GetAdj] subordination to your cause as a dominion?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2316`

## MECH_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_ACCEPT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_ACCEPT&lang=en)

确定，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetName]将成为你们的条约国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2246`

### English

Affirmative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will become your signatory.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2317`

## MECH_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_DEMAND_SIGNATORY_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

否定。[Root.GetName]将不会成为[From.GetAdj]的条约国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2247`

### English

Negative. The [Root.GetName] will not become a [From.GetAdj] signatory.

## MECH_ASK_BECOME_SIGNATORY_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_SIGNATORY_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]的独立生存率低于可接受水平。请求成为[Root.GetName]的条约国。我们将很好地为你们服务。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2248`

### English

Autonomous survival rates for the [From.GetName] are nearing unacceptable parameters. Requesting signatory status with the [Root.GetName]. We will serve you well.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2319`

## MECH_DEMAND_SATELLITE_ACCEPT

### 中文

确定。[Root.GetName]将成为[From.GetAdj]卫星国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2249`

### English

Affirmative. The [Root.GetName] will become a [From.GetAdj] satellite.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2320`

## MECH_DEMAND_SATELLITE_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_DEMAND_SATELLITE_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

否定，[From.GetSpeciesName]。[Root.GetName]将不会成为你们的卫星国。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2250`

### English

Negative, [From.GetSpeciesName]. The [Root.GetName] will not submit to becoming your satellite.
