## MECH_ASK_BECOME_SATELLITE_PROPOSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3AMECH_ASK_BECOME_SATELLITE_PROPOSE&lang=en)

### 中文

询问：[Root.GetName]是否愿意接受[From.GetName]成为卫星国？[From.GetName]的生存评估显示这是最符合逻辑的行为。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2251`

### English

Query: Will the [Root.GetName] accept the [From.GetName] as a satellite unit? Survival estimates for the [From.GetName] show this to be the most logical course of action.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2322`

## CRISIS_MATERIALIST_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_MATERIALIST_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，幸会，幸会。我猜你们的长、短距离传感器都准备好迎接将要到来的荣耀了吧？我们不想你们错过哪怕一瞬我们飞升时的荣光。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2253`

### English

Welcome, welcome, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We presume your long- and short-range sensors are primed for the glory that is to come? We would not want you to miss even one moment of our glorious ascension.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2327`

## CRISIS_SPIRITUALIST_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_SPIRITUALIST_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

说说吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]：当一个帝国灭亡之时，他们信仰的神明们也会随之消逝吗？要不要我们一起找出答案？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2254`

### English

Tell us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: when an empire dies, do they take their gods with them? Shall we find out together?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2328`

## CRISIS_PACIFIST_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_PACIFIST_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们拒绝武装自己并不能让你们免遭他人的武装进攻。但至少你们的牺牲将会十分迅速。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2255`

### English

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], your refusal to arm yourselves does not make you immune to the arms of others. But at least your sacrifice will be swift.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2329`

## CRISIS_MILITARIST_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_MILITARIST_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的武力威胁不过是一个注定要衰败的帝国在无力挣扎。最后一次拿起武器吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，然后用你们的死亡换取我们的新生。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2256`

### English

Your saber-rattling is but the pointless posturing of an empire doomed to fall. Raise your weapons one last time, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and give your lives for our new beginning.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2330`

## CRISIS_AUTHORITARIAN_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_AUTHORITARIAN_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

多么遗憾，即使那据称天赋异禀的[From.GetRulerTitle]也不能从命运手中挽救你们。我们要来对付你们喽，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2257`

### English

A pity, that even someone so purportedly blessed with talent as your [From.GetRulerTitle] cannot save you from your fate. We are coming for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2331`

## CRISIS_EGALITARIAN_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_EGALITARIAN_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你方民众联合起来反抗我们了，但这无济于事。你们没法一票否决自己的灭绝。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2258`

### English

Your people are united in defiance, but it will not save you. You cannot veto extinction.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2332`

## CRISIS_XENOPHILE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_XENOPHILE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们曾寻觅着外星生命，如今却胆敢拒绝我们。等我们成就事业之后，你们将会永远与星系的其余部分联合在一起。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2259`

### English

You sought alien life, but now you dare to reject us. When our work is complete you will be united with the rest of the galaxy, forever.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2333`

## CRISIS_XENOPHOBE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_XENOPHOBE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

当最初的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]仰望星空，它们感到了恐惧和疑问。你们的祖先是在依直觉行事，因为在寒冷的虚空中，你们遇见了我们。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2260`

### English

When the first [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] gazed upon the stars, they felt fear and suspicion. Your ancestors should have heeded that instinct, for it was in the cold void that you met us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2334`

## CRISIS_MACHINE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_MACHINE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

我们很感激能有这次机会，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们知道金属会尖啸；而通过你们我们将会知道机器是否能感到痛苦。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2261`

### English

We are grateful for this opportunity, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We know that metal can scream; through you will we learn if machines can suffer.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2335`

## CRISIS_HIVE_GREETING_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_HIVE_GREETING_01&lang=en)

### 中文

一个存在，无数躯体。[From.GetSpeciesName]，我们很好奇，如果你们那成百上千万具身体一起受到折磨，这会对你们的主脑产生什么影响？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2262`

### English

A single being, in myriad bodies. We wonder, [From.GetSpeciesName], what will the suffering of your millions of vessels do to your mind?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2336`

## CRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_01&lang=en)

### 中文

今天，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们来了。一只附肢拿着你们的§R灭绝§!，另一只附肢拿着我们的§Y飞升§!。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2263`

### English

It is time, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We come bearing your §Rextinction§! in one appendage and our §Yexaltation§! in the other.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2339`

## CRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_02

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_02&lang=en)

### 中文

让你们的人民做好准备，因为你们物种的终焉已然临近。你们对此无能为力，你们对我们也无能为力。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2264`

### English

Prepare your people, for the end of your species approaches. You can not stop it, nor can you stop us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2340`

## CRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_03

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_DOW_PROPOSE_03&lang=en)

### 中文

和平的幻灭如此轻易。[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们准备好同自己也许还残存有的一丝尊严一同毁灭了吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2265`

### English

The illusion of peace is so easily shattered. [Root.GetSpeciesName], are you ready to die with whatever shred of dignity you have left?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2341`

## CRISIS_DOW_ACCEPT_01

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_DOW_ACCEPT_01&lang=en)

### 中文

你们加速了自己的毁灭，我们对你们就消灭自己整个物种的支持表示赞赏。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2266`

### English

You hasten your own demise, and we appreciate your support in the extermination of your entire species.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2342`

## CRISIS_PEACE_ACCEPT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_PEACE_ACCEPT&lang=en)

### 中文

暂时的挫折。不用怕，你们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]终有一天会成为我们飞升的燃料。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2267`

### English

A temporary setback. Fear not, you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will fuel our ascension, in time.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2343`

## CRISIS_PEACE_REFUSE

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_PEACE_REFUSE&lang=en)

### 中文

[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们的飞升不会中止。现在不会，永远也不会。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2268`

### English

Our ascent will not be halted, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Not now, not ever.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2344`

## CRISIS_EMBASSY_SELECT

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3ACRISIS_EMBASSY_SELECT&lang=en)

### 中文

## 01_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY

## 02_REJECT_BREAK_SECRET_FEALTY_FRIENDLY

## 01_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM&lang=en)

### 中文

前路愈发黑暗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]将与任何愿意让群星继续闪耀的人站在一起。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2516`

### English

The road grows darker, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] will stand with any who would keep the stars lit.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2627`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM&lang=en)

### 中文

已确认系统性威胁。[Root.GetName]将与[From.GetName]协调以维护存续。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2517`

### English

Systemic threat acknowledged. The [Root.GetName] will coordinate with the [From.GetName] to preserve continuity.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2628`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM&lang=en)

### 中文

阴影笼罩了所有生灵。[Root.GetName]与[From.GetName]并肩前行。我们将共同度过难关。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2518`

### English

A shadow falls across all living things. The [Root.GetName] moves alongside the [From.GetName]. We will endure it together.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2629`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM&lang=en)

### 中文

如此规模的危机同时威胁着[Root.GetName]和[From.GetName]。合作……暂时是有利可图的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2519`

### English

A crisis of this scale threatens both the [Root.GetName] and the [From.GetName]. Cooperation is… temporarily profitable.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2630`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM&lang=en)

### 中文

当黑暗降临，即使是流浪者也必须成为牧羊人。与我们同行吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2520`

### English

When darkness rises, even wanderers must become shepherds. Walk with us, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2631`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_FROM&lang=en)

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2521`

### English

Whatever comes for the galaxy will face the fleets of the [Root.GetName] first. Stand with us, or stand aside.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2632`

## 01_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_FROM

The [Root.GetName] answers your signal. What does our patron, the [From.GetName], require of the fleet?

### English

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_FROM

### English

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_FROM

### English

The [Root.GetName] is listening. Let us review obligations, support, and expectations with the [From.GetName].

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_FROM

### English

We walk the star-road beneath your protection, [From.GetName]. Speak, our [Root.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] are open.

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_FROM

### English

The convoy of the [Root.GetName] remains battle-ready and answerable to the [From.GetName]. Give your orders.

## 01_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

原来这些就是[From.GetName]的流浪者。没有母星，无根无萍——然而在听到我们的呼叫时，那些[From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]还是竖了起来。你们一定很孤独吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2528`

### English

So these are the drifters of the [From.GetName]. No homeworld, no roots - and yet those [From.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] still prick up at our hail. How lonely you must be.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2641`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]表现出低效的游荡。没有世界锚点的文明应该从星系记录中被清除。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2529`

### English

The [From.GetName] exhibits inefficient wandering. A civilization without a world anchor should be cleaned up from the galactic records.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2642`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]四处游荡，没有巢穴可供进食。星系应当进化到一个没有你们存在的状态。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2530`

### English

The [From.GetName] wanders without a nest to feed from. The galaxy should evolve to exist without you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2643`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

没有办公室，没有控股，没有固定资产。告诉我们，[From.GetName]，你为什么还没有申请破产？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2531`

### English

No offices, no holdings, no fixed assets. Tell us, [From.GetName], why haven't you filed for bankruptcy?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2644`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

没有圣地，也没有神圣的家园，你们四处流浪，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，在冰冷的黑暗中抚养着你们的[From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]。这真是一种可悲的生存方式。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2532`

### English

You wander without holy ground or sacred hearth, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], raising your [From.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] in the cold dark. It is a pitiable way to exist.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2645`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

一个没有领土的种族，距离灭绝仅有一败之遥。记住这点，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2533`

### English

A people without territory is a people one defeat away from extinction. Remember that, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2646`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_WAR_GREETING_TO

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2666`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_WAR_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_WAR_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

你们躲在机动与护航屏障之后，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们会将它们一并粉碎。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2551`

### English

You hide behind movement and convoy screens, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We will break both.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2667`

## 01_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

对于一个连自己能叫出名字的世界都没有的种族来说，你们的骄傲真是令人费解，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2552`

### English

Your pride is strange for a people who own no world they can name, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2669`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]在历史长河中随波逐流，却将其称之为适应。我们对此依然不以为然。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2553`

### English

The [From.GetName] drifts through history and calls it adaptation. We remain unconvinced.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2670`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]在历史中随波逐流，并称之为适应。蜂群不为所动。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2554`

### English

The [From.GetName] drifts through history and calls it adaptation. The swarm is not moved.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2671`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

一支妄自尊大的舰队依然只是贬值资产，[From.GetName]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2555`

### English

A fleet with delusions of grandeur is still a depreciating asset, [From.GetName].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2672`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

不要将流浪与超脱混为一谈，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2556`

### English

Do not confuse wandering with transcendence, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2673`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_ARROGANT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

机动性是有用的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。它并不能替代力量。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2557`

### English

Mobility is useful, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It is not a substitute for power.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2674`

## 01_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

你们的舰队近乎放肆，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。给我一个解释。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2558`

### English

Your fleet edges too close to insolence, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Explain yourselves.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2676`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]距离化为碎片仅有一步之遥。修正你的航向。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2559`

### English

The [From.GetName] is one deviation from becoming debris. Correct your course.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2677`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]激怒了它无法逃脱的存在。蜂群的耐心不是无限的。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2560`

### English

The [From.GetName] provokes what it cannot outrun. The swarm's patience is not infinite.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2678`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

我们对[From.GetName]正在失去耐心，而且拖延的成本越来越高。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2561`

### English

We are losing patience with the [From.GetName], and the cost of delay is increasing.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2679`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

你们流浪的人民心中充满愤怒，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，却少有智慧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2562`

### English

There is anger in your wandering people, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and little wisdom in it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2680`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_BELLIGERENT_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

如果[From.GetName]是来找茬的，直说就行。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2563`

### English

If the [From.GetName] came looking for a fight, just say so.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2681`

## 01_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]，如果你确实有意协助坚守防线，[Root.GetName]将会听取你的意见。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2564`

### English

[From.GetName], if you truly intend to help hold the line, the [Root.GetName] will hear you.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2683`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]具备高机动性。这提高了它在当前条件下的战略价值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2565`

### English

The [From.GetName] possesses high mobility. This increases its strategic value in current conditions.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2684`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]如蜂群般行动自如。在黑暗的时代，这让你们对我们极具价值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2566`

### English

The [From.GetName] moves freely, as the swarm does. In dark times, this makes you valuable to us.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2685`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

像[From.GetName]这样的舰队在危机中具有明确的作战价值。让我们来讨论一下条件吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2567`

### English

A fleet like the [From.GetName] has clear operational value in a crisis. Let us discuss terms.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2686`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

即使是流浪者也能成为一方守护，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]欢迎你们的援助。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2568`

### English

Even wanderers may serve as guardians, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] welcomes your aid.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2687`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_CUSTODIAL_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

如果[From.GetName]已经为真正的战争做好了准备，那就请讲。[Root.GetName]洗耳恭听。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2569`

### English

If the [From.GetName] is ready for real war, then speak. The [Root.GetName] is listening.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2688`

## 01_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]，你的继续通行取决于秩序。你需要[Root.GetName]的指示吗？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2570`

### English

[From.GetName], your continued passage depends on order. Do you require instruction from the [Root.GetName]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2690`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]仍受[Root.GetName]的监督。请保持顺从。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2571`

### English

The [From.GetName] remains under supervision of the [Root.GetName]. Maintain compliance.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2691`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]遵循[Root.GetName]的意志行动。切勿偏离。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2572`

### English

The [From.GetName] moves within the will of the [Root.GetName]. Do not stray from it.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2692`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

像[From.GetName]这样的移动子公司需要明确的条款。让我们来审核一下您的条款。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2573`

### English

Mobile subsidiaries like the [From.GetName] require clear terms. Let us review yours.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2693`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的流浪者们，不要将[Root.GetName]的指引误认为是软弱。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2574`

### English

Wanderers of the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do not mistake the guidance of the [Root.GetName] for weakness.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2694`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_OVERLORD_GREETING_TO&lang=en)

### 中文

无论有没有方舟舰，[From.GetName]都要听命于[Root.GetName]。说吧。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2575`

### English

Arkships or not, the [From.GetName] answers to the [Root.GetName]. Speak.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2695`

## 01_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

又是一支流浪舰队，[From.GetName]？你们今天打算怎么浪费[Root.GetName]的时间？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2576`

### English

Another wandering fleet, the [From.GetName]? How are you wasting the time of the [Root.GetName] today?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2697`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]未与[Root.GetName]在路线上一致。从我们的驿道中改道。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2577`

### English

The [From.GetName] is not aligned with the [Root.GetName]. Deviate from our Waylines.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2698`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]与[Root.GetName]毫不和谐。也许你们的方舟舰应该被静默。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2578`

### English

The [From.GetName] are disharmonious to the [Root.GetName]. Perhaps your Arkships should be silenced.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2699`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]提供不了任何[Root.GetName]无法在别处获得的东西。这场会议纯属浪费时间，我们将向你们发送账单。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2579`

### English

The [From.GetName] offers nothing the [Root.GetName] cannot acquire elsewhere. We will be sending an invoice for this waste of a meeting.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2700`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

虚空承载着许多朝圣者，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，以及同样多的愚者。但[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并非愚者。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2580`

### English

The void bears many pilgrims, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and just as many fools. The [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not the fools.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2701`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_HOSTILE_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

让[From.GetName]的船队远离[Root.GetName]的驿站，你们或许能在这场遭遇中幸存下来。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2581`

### English

Keep the [From.GetName] convoy clear of the [Root.GetName] Waystations, and you may survive this encounter.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2702`

## 01_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A01_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

另一支方舟舰队，[From.GetName]？幸会，[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]。是什么让你们与[Root.GetName]的航道交汇？

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2582`

### English

A fellow Arkship fleet, the [From.GetName]? Well met, [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]. What brings you across the path of the [Root.GetName]?

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2704`

## 02_MACHINE_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_MACHINE_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

另一个迁徙智能[From.GetName]进入了[Root.GetName]的范围内。已发出确认信号。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2583`

### English

Another migrating intelligence, [From.GetName], enters range of the [Root.GetName]. Acknowledgment issued.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2705`

## 02_HIVE_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A02_HIVE_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]通常独自旅行。向你们致敬，各位旅人。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2584`

### English

We [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] usually travel alone. Greetings to you, fellow sojourners.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2706`

## 03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A03_MEGACORP_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

[From.GetName]遇到了[Root.GetName]。很好。双方都懂得保持居无定所的价值。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2585`

### English

The [From.GetName] meets the [Root.GetName]. Good. Two parties who understand the value of staying mobile.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2707`

## 04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A04_SPIRITUALIST_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)

### 中文

又一个跋涉于漫长旅途的种族，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。群星让你们与[Root.GetName]的轨迹交汇，定有其深意。

Source: `localisation/simp_chinese/dip_messages_l_simp_chinese.yml:2586`

### English

Another people of the long road, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The stars have crossed your path with the [Root.GetName] for a reason.

Source: `localisation/english/dip_messages_l_english.yml:2708`

## 05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH

Namespace: `gameplay` · Status: `paired` · [Viewer](https://wangyufeng.org/stellaris/?entry=gameplay%3A05_MILITARIST_NOMAD_NEUTRAL_GREETING_BOTH&lang=en)
